plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Answer me with HTML
in Shimo Style

An agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML in Shimo Docs style.
Markdown in. One self-contained page out. No server, no build step.

Demo · Install · Theme · Development

The built-in shimo theme. Run am config set mode dark, or use the page toolbar, for the dark variant.

## Why this fork? [Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) already turns a Markdown draft into one clean HTML page. This fork adds a **project-native Shimo Docs theme** and makes it the default, so every page looks like a document someone would actually read. | | Original | This fork | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | CLI, drafts, components, videos | ✅ | ✅ unchanged | | Themes | blueprint · shadcn · paper · 3b1b | + **`shimo`**, built in and default | | Look | technical board / cards / paper | white square page on `#f7f7f7`, 30px/700 title, 15px/1.7 body | | Quality | — | `0 errors · 0 warnings`, WCAG AA contrast | ## ✨ Features | Feature | What you get | | :--- | :--- | | 🎨 **Shimo Docs by default** | White page, thin gray rules, neutral grays and one accessible Shimo blue. | | 📄 **One file, offline** | The output is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JS. No server, no CDN. | | 🧩 **Real components** | Tables, code blocks, callouts, flow / sequence / ER diagrams, charts, timelines, trees and math. | | 🌗 **Light & dark** | Both palettes are token-driven and pass the theme's contrast checks. | | ⚡ **Fast** | The model writes a short Markdown draft; the bundled CLI does layout and SVG coordinates. | | 🧪 **Controlled writing** | The STE check flags wordy sentences and overlong paragraphs before the page is written. | ## 🚀 Install You need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20 or newer. There is no `npm install` step: the CLI is bundled inside the skill. ### Let your agent install it Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness or another agent: > Install Answer me with HTML in Shimo Style: read > https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style/main/INSTALL.md and follow it. ### One command ```bash npx skills add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ``` The installer ([vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills)) asks which agents to install into. ### Claude Code plugin ``` /plugin marketplace add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style /plugin install answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style@answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ``` ### DeepSeek Harness plugin ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ```
Manual install ```bash git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style.git /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style cp -R /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ~/.claude/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ``` Other skill folders: Codex `~/.codex/skills/`, Cursor `~/.cursor/skills/`, OpenCode `~/.config/opencode/skill/`, DeepSeek Harness `~/.dsh/skills/`.
## 🧩 Use Ask a question the way you always do: ``` > Explain the TCP three-way handshake > Redis or Memcached for our cache? > Map out how the modules in this repo fit together ``` The agent writes a short Markdown draft and runs the bundled CLI. The page goes to `~/.answer-me-with-html/pages/` (the same data folder as the original project; install one or the other, because settings and pages are shared). Open it in a browser. Change settings with the agent (`config`), or directly: ```bash am config # show settings; theme defaults to shimo am config set theme auto # content-based theme choice am config set theme shimo # back to the Shimo Docs theme am config set mode dark # dark palette am list # templates, themes, components ``` On the page itself, the top-right toolbar switches theme and light/dark mode, opens comments, and copies the reply Markdown back to the agent. ## 🎨 The Shimo look The theme follows measurements from the Shimo editor (2026-10). Nothing is hand-waved: the tokens below are the same ones the theme checks and ships. | Element | Value | Where it shows | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Canvas | `#f7f7f7` | page background | | Paper | `#ffffff` + `0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.13)` | square page with a quiet shadow | | Title / body | `30px/700` · `15px/1.7` | document title and prose | | Ink | `#3a3a3a` · `#6b6b6b` · `#9a9a9a` | text, secondary text, metadata | | Rules | `#e7e7e7` · `#efefef` | table borders and hairlines | | Fill | `#f5f5f5` | table headers, code blocks, inline code | | Accent | `#2b68c2` | links, focus rings, highlights | | Diagram | `#d5dae1` strokes · `#eaf2fe` highlights | flow, sequence, ER, charts | The theme source is [`src/themes/shimo.js`](src/themes/shimo.js). A user theme with the same name in `~/.answer-me-with-html/themes/shimo.json` would shadow it; do not install one if you want the built-in version.
Doc template preview

## 🔄 How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR Q[Question] --> D[Markdown draft] D --> C[Bundled am CLI] C --> T[shimo theme tokens] T --> P[Single HTML page] ``` The model never writes HTML, CSS or SVG. It writes the draft; the CLI owns layout, colors, dark mode, diagram coordinates and the writing checks. ## 📁 Project layout ```text skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/ the skill: SKILL.md, references and the bundled CLI src/themes/shimo.js the Shimo theme source (built into the CLI) demo/ the GitHub Pages demo (index.md → index.html) .github/workflows/pages.yml renders the demo and deploys it to Pages ``` ## 🛠 Development ```bash npm ci npm run build # rebuild skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs npm test ``` `skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs` is generated. Edit `src/`, then run `npm run build` and commit both. ## ⚖️ Credits & license Forked from [Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) by QingYunA, MIT. Th

plugins.description: bilibili-note 的 DSH 插件封装版（衍生自 3588834014-del/bilibili-note）：把 B站视频链接变成 Obsidian 结构化笔记，只拉字幕不下载视频。
plugins.readme_text:
# bilibili-note

> **DSH plugin packaging of [`3588834014-del/bilibili-note`](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note).**
>
> This repository is the **plugin edition**: the upstream project plus a DeepSeek Harness
> bundle wrapper (`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `lib/index.js`). The original
> skill + CLI lives upstream — use that one if you don't need to install it as a dsh plugin.
> GitHub does not allow forking a repository into the same account, so this is a derivative
> copy rather than a fork-network fork.

> **Turn Bilibili videos into structured Obsidian notes — subtitles only, never the video.**
>
> 中文说明见 [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)。

[![CI](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.8+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.8%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

A small CLI — plus an optional agent skill — that turns a Bilibili video into a structured
Markdown note in your Obsidian vault. It downloads **only the subtitle file** (`--skip-download`),
cleans the timestamps, and writes a note with YAML front matter, a summary section, bullet
points carrying clickable `?t=` jump links, and the full transcript collapsed at the bottom.

The repetitive half (fetch, parse, format, verify) is a script. The judgment half (summary,
key points, tags) is left as a documented contract you or an agent fill in.

```
Bilibili URL ──▶ fetch ──▶ manifest.json ──▶ [you / agent] ──▶ content.json ──▶ write ──▶ note.md
                  │         subtitles +                      summary, bullets,       │
                  │         timestamped segments             tags                    │
                  └── yt-dlp, subtitles only ────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Real output

`fetch` on a real video — note what is *not* there: no `.mp4`, `.flv`, `.m4a` or `.part`,
only the subtitle file and its manifest.

![fetch: subtitles only, no media files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/main/docs/images/demo-fetch.png)

And the note it produces (Obsidian rendering — front matter, clickable `?t=` jump links,
summary, bullets, tags). Screenshot taken from a real run, not a mock-up:

![the generated note](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/main/docs/images/demo-note.png)

## Why this one

- **Subtitles only.** `--skip-download` is mandatory, and the tool verifies no media file
  (`.mp4/.flv/.m4a/.part`) landed in the working directory. No reverse-engineering, no
  private APIs — just `yt-dlp`.
- **Multi-part videos are merged.** For an anthology (B站 分P 合集) it fetches every part's
  subtitles and rebases the timestamps onto one continuous timeline. Verified on a real
  6-part anthology: **2:10:32 → 2807 segments / 33214 characters**, matching an independent
  concatenation segment-for-segment. A part with no subtitles is skipped **while keeping its
  time slot**, so later timestamps stay correct.
- **It refuses to produce garbage.** If two parts yield byte-identical subtitles, it errors out
  instead of silently emitting a note whose content is one part repeated N times. (That exact
  bug shipped during development and was caught by this guard.)
- **No subtitles? It skips and tells you.** It never fabricates content or writes an empty note.

## Install

No dependencies — standard library only. `yt-dlp` is an **external command**, not a Python package.

### As a DSH plugin (recommended for DeepSeek Harness)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:3588834014-del/bilibili-note-plugin
```

This is a **bundle plugin** that registers the `bilibili-note` skill straight into the DSH skill
catalog — no manual copying into `~/.agents/skills`. Restart your profile afterwards and the
skill is available; the model picks it up from phrases like 「B站笔记」 or a pasted BV link.

The plugin ships its own copy of `scripts/bili_note.py`, `docs/` and `SKILL.md`, and rewrites
the `<skill-dir>` placeholders in the skill body to the **absolute install path**, so the model
never has to guess where the script lives. Uninstall with
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bilibili-note`.

> There is no npm package yet, so this plugin is **source-installed** — it is listed on
> [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org) but will not appear in the in-app plugin store.
> pnpm ≥10 may ask you to allow the git dependency's build script; this package has no
> `prepare` script, so nothing runs at install time.

### As a standalone CLI

```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note.git
# or
git clone https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note.git
cd bilibili-note && python -m pip install .
```

Then:

```bash
bili-note --version
bili-note note "https://www.bilibili.com/video/BVxxxxxxxxx" \
    --note-dir ~/MyVault/Sources/Videos
```

### As a plain agent skill (no plugin)

```bash
python scripts/install.py            # installs to ~/.agents/skills/bilibili-note
python scripts/install.py --dry-run  # show what would be copied
```

The skill then appears in the dsh skill catalog and can be triggered with phrases like
「B站笔记」. The plugin, the skill-file install and the CLI all share the same implementation
(`scripts/bili_note.py`).

### Requirements

| Requirement | Notes |
|---|---|
| Python 3.8+ | stdlib only |
| [`yt-dlp`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) | `pip install -U yt-dlp` — the **only** download channel |
| Bilibili login cookies | Required for AI subtitles; see below |
| DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` | Only for the plugin/skill route |

### Permissions and external services

Worth knowing before you install, since this tool touches the network and your vault:

- **Network**: talks to `bilibili.com` through `yt-dlp` only. It downloads **subtitles**, never
  video or audio (`--skip-download` is mandatory and verified).
- **Credentials**: reads a Bilibili cookie file from `$BILI_COOKIES` or `./cookies.txt`. It
  writes a **normalized temporary copy** next to the work dir for yt-dlp; it never uploads,
  logs, or commits cookies.
- **Filesystem**: writes notes into the `--note-dir` you pass, plus a scratch work directory.
  Nothing outside those two paths is modified.
- **No telemetry, no extra dependencies**, no reverse-engineered APIs.

## Cookies (required)

Bilibili's AI-subtitle endpoint needs an authenticated session.

1. Install the **Get cookies.txt LOCALLY** browser extension.
2. Log into [bilibili.com](https://www.bilibili.com).
3. Export `cookies.txt`.
4. Put it in your working directory, or point at it:

```bash
export BILI_COOKIES=/path/to/cookies.txt      # Linux / macOS
$env:BILI_COOKIES = "C:\path\cookies.txt"     # PowerShell
```

Videos where the uploader supplied their own subtitles may work without this.

### ⚠️ Why you can't feed the export straight to yt-dlp

This is the single most surprising thing in this repository. That extension writes lines like:

```
.bilibili.com	FALSE	/	FALSE	1819635894	SESSDATA	xxxxx
```

The domain carries a leading dot, yet the host-only flag in column 2 is `FALSE`. Python's
`http.cookiejar` asserts:

```python
assert domain_specified == initial_dot
```

The mismatch raises, and yt-dlp refuses to load the **entire file**:

```
ERROR: invalid Netscape format cookies file '...': '.bilibili.com\tFALSE\t/...'
```

The practical symptom is nasty: subtitles never arrive, and the error looks like
*"this video has no subtitles."* The fix is normalization — strip the leading dot and set the
flag to `FALSE` (a host-only cookie is still sent to `api.bilibili.com` and friends, so the
session is preserved). `normalize_cookies()` does this, plus filters to the `bilibili` domain
and de-duplicates by `domain/path/name`. You never have to do it by hand.

## Output directory

Nothing is hard-coded. Pick either:

```bash
bili-note note "<URL>" --note-dir "<vault>/Sources/Videos"    # explicit

export BILI_VAULT="/path/to/MyVault"                           # or environment
export BILI_TARGET_DIR="Sources/Videos"

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn sidebar entries into a compact icon row, with adjustable icon size and per-entry visibility.
plugins.readme_text:
# 侧栏图标并列（sidebar-icon-row）

DeepSeek Harness 插件的侧栏入口默认都是 42px 整行，所以「插件广场 / 远程控制 / 面板入口」会一条一行。
本插件把它们压成 36×36 的图标方块并排显示，并提供设置页。

- 面板入口（`sidebar.panellist`）与底部入口（`sidebar.footer.action`）统一处理；
- 「今日 / 余额」卡片仍独占一整行（沿用 cost-meter 自己的 `.cm-footer-stack`）；
- 每个入口只显示图标，常驻文字隐藏，悬停时在图标上方显示名称（纯 CSS `::after` + `aria-label`）；
- 侧栏收起成 56px 轨道时保持原样（图标竖排）；
- 底部新增一个「设置」齿轮入口，一键打开 DSH 设置页；
- 设置页里可调图标大小（16 / 18 / 20 / 24）、逐个开关入口、并调整图标先后顺序。

## 实现方式

- 只注入一个 `<style>` 节点，不修改任何宿主或其他插件的组件；
- 选择器用 `[data-slot="sidebar.footer.action"] > *` 与 `[class*="panelList"]` / `[class*="panelRow"]` 锚定，
  不使用 `_2H3hWW_` 这类带构建哈希的类名；
- 侧栏入口按渲染出来的名字（`aria-label` 优先）打上 `data-sir-key`，隐藏与排序都作用在这个属性上，
  关闭的入口直接 `display: none !important`（内联），所以不依赖选择器优先级；
- 排序通过给每个入口写 `order` 实现，不移动 DOM；
- 设置存在浏览器 `localStorage`（键 `dsh.sidebar-icon-row.v1`），按浏览器各自保存。

## 设置页

`插件 → 已安装插件 → 侧栏图标并列`。设置区注册在 `plugins.bundle.config`（key 为包名），
在插件页描述下方、插件行上方渲染。

## 安装 / 卸载

```powershell
# 安装（当前 profile；源码就放在 profile 的 local-plugins 下，不依赖工作区）
dsh plugin install "E:\DeepseekHarness-data\data\profiles\desktop\local-plugins\sidebar-icon-row"
# 卸载
dsh plugin remove dsh-sidebar-icon-row
```

安装后刷新页面；新增 bundle 首次加载可能需要重启一次 `dsh web`。

## 回滚

在插件管理里关掉「侧栏图标并列」，或卸载本包：样式随 `<style>` 清理消失，
额外的「设置」图标随 `sidebar.footer.action` 的注册一并移除。

plugins.description: Expose the running DeepSeek Harness Web GUI's authenticated URL as an agent tool (gui_auth_url), so browser automation can open the GUI instead of failing with 401. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gui-auth-url

[![CI](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.1--rc.2%20%3C0.3.0--0-6f42c1)](package.json)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url?style=social)](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url/stargazers)

> Third-party community plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Not an official DeepSeek product. MIT licensed.

English | [中文](README-zh.md) | [Español](README-es.md) | [Português](README-pt.md) | [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

Expose the running DeepSeek Harness Web GUI's **authenticated URL** as an agent tool, so browser automation and scripts can open the GUI instead of hitting `401 dsh web authentication required`.

## The problem

`dsh --profile web` mints a random launch token per process and prints it once:

```text
dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=...
```

`GET /?token=...` verifies the token, sets a signed cookie bound to host:port, and redirects to `/`. Opening the bare address returns:

```text
401 dsh web authentication required; reopen the URL printed by dsh web.
```

The Desktop edition starts its own Host process on a random port and never prints that line, so any external browser or automation tool opening `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/` always gets 401. There is no `--no-browser-auth` switch today.

## How it works

The plugin runs inside the Host process and asks the official public API `connection.authenticatedUrl(baseUrl)` — the same call `dsh web` uses to build the URL it prints — then returns the result as a tool result.

It never reads the cookie-signing secret in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` and never mints a cookie itself, so the URL is a genuine first-party session bound to this process.

Base URL resolution prefers `webApp.getAdvertisedUrl()` (respects `--public-url` and mounts), then `webServer.getOrigin()`, then protocol plus loopback port. Every call re-reads the live value, so random Desktop ports and restarted tokens need no cache. The token is attached only when that base is absolute `http` or `https`, has no username or password, and — unless the plugin config sets `allowPublic: true` — names a loopback host (`127.0.0.0/8`, `localhost`, or `::1`). The returned URL must be that same origin and carry exactly one `token`. An unacceptable base is refused before `authenticatedUrl` is called, and the error text never includes the URL.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` writes the bundle into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically. Restart DeepSeek Harness and the tool appears.

Local checkout instead:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-gui-auth-url
```

The package is published on npm as `dsh-gui-auth-url`. GitHub is the source repository.

Upgrading from the old name `dsh-gui-session` (0.1.x): the package name, Cordis row id and tool name all changed, so reinstall once:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-gui-session
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url
```

## Usage

The plugin registers one tool, `gui_auth_url`, with no parameters. It returns:

```json
{
  "url": "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=...",
  "origin": "http://127.0.0.1:3080",
  "protocol": "http:",
  "host": "127.0.0.1",
  "port": "3080",
  "secure": false
}
```

The model sees the `url` text; the other fields are available to programmatic callers. Hand the URL to `navigate_page`, `curl`, or any HTTP client to enter the GUI.

Typical use: while debugging DeepSeek Harness itself, let the agent open the live GUI with chrome-devtools-mcp and verify layout, interaction and RPC for real instead of guessing from code.

## Security

- The returned URL contains **this process's launch token**. It is a credential equivalent to a signed-in session and only works while the Host process is alive.
- Do not write it to logs, commit it, or paste it into chats. Regenerate by calling the tool again; a restart invalidates it.
- A successful call still places the token in the session transcript and in later model requests. "Do not write it to logs" does not stop the host from storing the tool result. That is a wider audience than the one line `dsh web` prints in a terminal.
- The plugin does not read `.credentials.yaml` and does not mint cookies.
- Non-loopback URLs (`--public-url`, a LAN address, or `0.0.0.0`) are refused unless the plugin config is exactly `allowPublic: true`. That flag trusts the advertised host.
- It is unrelated to [Discussion #8678](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8678) (reading the signing secret inside a sandbox to forge cookies): this plugin never touches that secret.

## Compatibility

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` |
| Node | `>=22.19.0` |
| Verified on | dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`, Windows x64, desktop and web profiles |
| Web combination | needs the `connection` service; a profile without a Web GUI reports a clear error |

Display metadata (`locale/*.json` plus the exported `./icon`) makes the Plugins page and Settings show a proper title, description and artwork instead of the raw package id. The plugin does not require a build step: it ships plain ESM JavaScript.

## Troubleshooting

**The tool does not appear after install.** Check that the profile's `package.json` lists `dsh-gui-auth-url` in `dsh.profile.bundles`. `dsh plugin add` normally writes it, but a failed install can leave only the dependency:

```json
{
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-gui-auth-url"] } }
}
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness, then confirm with `dsh --profile <name> --dump-config` and look for the `gui-auth-url` row.

**Installation rejected because of a version mismatch.** DSH checks `engines.dsh` (or dsh peer ranges) at install time. If your host is outside the declared range, grant the exact-version exemption, reinstall, and revoke it once a compatible release exists:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> version-exemptions
dsh plugin --profile <profile> allow-version dsh-gui-auth-url@0.2.1 --dsh-version <runtime> --accept-risk
dsh plugin --profile <profile> revoke-version dsh-gui-auth-url@0.2.1
```

**`EPERM: rename ... node_modules\dsh-gui-auth-url_tmp_*` on Windows.** Stop the DSH process using that profile, delete the stale `node_modules\dsh-gui-auth-url` directory, and retry. A running process locks the directory.

**"This profile serves no Web GUI".** The plugin only returns a URL when the profile mounts `webApp` or `webServer` plus `connection`. Headless-style profiles have no GUI to open.

**"refusing to attach the launch token to a non-loopback host".** The advertised URL is not loopback. The token is not returned. To allow that host, set this entry in the profile patch. A later patch replaces the whole `config` object, so keep any other keys you need in that same object:

```yaml
- id: gui-auth-url
  config:
    allowPublic: true
```

Leave `allowPublic` unset on a Desktop loopback profile. The flag trusts whatever `webApp.getAdvertisedUrl()` returns.

## Development

```bash
node --test test/*.test.js          # unit + manifest compliance tests
node --check src/index.js && node --check src/auth-url.js
npm run check:pack                  # verifies the published tarball contents
```

```text
src/auth-url.js    pure helpers: base URL resolution + Host session call (unit-tested)
src/index.js       Cordis plugin entry: registers the gui_auth_url tool
locale/            display metadata (en, zh, es, pt, hi)
test/              node:test suites, including packaging invariants
scripts/           tarball check used by prepublishOnly and CI
```

The plugin only registers a tool; `ctx.tools.register` returns the disposer that Cordis owns, so unloading or hot-reloading the pl

plugins.description: Ollama Cloud web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with a Web UI settings card.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ollama-web

English | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

Ollama Cloud web search and optional web fetch provider for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), with a Web UI settings card. One npm package provides both the host backend and the browser card. Search uses Ollama; `web_fetch` stays on DSH's built-in HTTP provider unless you explicitly enable the optional Ollama fetch provider.

[![Support via Buy Me a Coffee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Buy%20Me%20a%20Coffee-FFDD00?style=flat-square&logo=buymeacoffee&logoColor=black)](https://buymeacoffee.com/explorrrr)

- Search endpoint defaults to `https://ollama.com/api/web_search`
- Optional fetch endpoint defaults to `https://ollama.com/api/web_fetch`; off by default
- Configure the API key in the card (write-only) or via `OLLAMA_API_KEY`
- Update checks, install, and opt-in auto-update are included
- Default `web_fetch` remains the credential-free DSH HTTP provider

## Requirements

- DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (peer `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`), tested on this version
- DSH 0.3.x is not supported yet (planned for 3.0); see [docs/COMPATIBILITY.md](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)
- Node.js >= 20.3
- An Ollama Cloud API key from <https://ollama.com/settings/keys>

## Install

One package provides the `web_search` backend, the optional fetch provider and the settings card. Install it once.

1. Add the package.

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ollama-web@2.4.0
   ```

   Replace `desktop` with your profile name if needed. You can also use **Plugins -> Add plugin** in the Web UI. npm: [dsh-ollama-web](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ollama-web)

2. Pin the search provider in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`.

   ```yaml
   - id: web
     config:
       searchProvider: ollama
       fetchProvider: http

   # Only if the built-in DeepSeek search provider is mounted.
   - id: web-search-deepseek
     disabled: true
   ```

   `fetchProvider: http` keeps `web_fetch` on DSH's built-in HTTP provider.

### Optional Ollama fetch provider

To use Ollama for `web_fetch`, enable the provider **and** pin it. Both entries are required:

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: ollama
    fetchProvider: ollama

- id: ollama-web
  config:
    enableFetchProvider: true
```

`web` replaces its whole config, so keep `searchProvider: ollama` when you change `fetchProvider`. With only `enableFetchProvider: true`, `web_fetch` reports `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS` because both the HTTP and Ollama fetch providers are usable. With only `fetchProvider: ollama`, it reports `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE` because the Ollama provider is disabled. You can also enable the provider from the settings card, but the `web.fetchProvider: ollama` pin still belongs in the profile patch.

Ollama does not expose the target page's HTTP status or final redirect URL. A successful Ollama fetch is reported to DSH as `HTTP 200` for the requested URL; title, main content and links are folded into the text result. Keep `fetchProvider: http` when target status fidelity or DSH's local SSRF boundary matters.

### Upgrading from 1.x

2.0.0 merges the former `dsh-ollama-web-client` package into `dsh-ollama-web`. Remove the old package before installing 2.4.0:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-ollama-web-client
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-ollama-web@2.4.0
```

The 1.x updater checks both old packages and only auto-installs the current major. Because 2.0.0 is not published as a new `dsh-ollama-web-client`, it will not move you to 2.0.0; the upgrade is manual. In the desktop app, remove the `dsh-ollama-web-client` bundle in **Plugins**, then install `dsh-ollama-web@2.4.0`. Leaving the old client installed can register the settings card twice and is not supported.

## Configure

### API key

Enter it in the settings card (**Plugins -> `dsh-ollama-web` -> `ollama-web` -> Configure**), or set `OLLAMA_API_KEY` in the environment that launches DSH. The card is write-only: leaving the key blank keeps the current key, and a saved key is never shown again.

### Settings

| Field | Default | Constraint |
|---|---|---|
| `baseURL` | `https://ollama.com` | HTTPS only; no userinfo/query/fragment |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `OLLAMA_API_KEY` | `^OLLAMA_[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` |
| `searchPath` | `/api/web_search` | Absolute path under the baseURL path, same origin |
| `maxResults` | `5` | 1-10 |
| `snippetMax` | `2000` | 1-10000 characters |
| `maxQueryChars` | `2048` | 1-8192 characters |
| `searchTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 1000-120000 ms |
| `maxResponseBytes` | `2097152` | 65536-10485760 bytes |
| `fetchPath` | `/api/web_fetch` | Absolute path under the baseURL path, same origin |
| `fetchTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 1000-120000 ms |
| `fetchMaxChars` | `100000` | 1-200000 characters |
| `enableFetchProvider` | `false` | Live boolean; requires `web.fetchProvider: ollama` |
| `apiKey` | unset | Secret; prefer the card or `OLLAMA_API_KEY` |

`apiKeyEnv` accepts only `OLLAMA_*` names. Other environment variables and credential references are rejected before a request is made.

## Usage

Ask the model to search, then check that results come from Ollama. The search request body contains only the query and `max_results`; the API key is sent in the `Authorization: Bearer` header. The default endpoint is `https://ollama.com/api/web_search`.

When the optional fetch provider is enabled and pinned, `web_fetch` sends only `{ "url": "..." }` to `https://ollama.com/api/web_fetch` with the same Bearer key. Ollama returns `title`, main-content `content` and `links`; this plugin folds them into a text result and caps it at `fetchMaxChars`. The request URL is returned as the result URL and the status is always `200` on success, because Ollama does not expose the target status or final redirect URL.

### If the settings card does not appear

1. Confirm `dsh-ollama-web` is installed and its bundle is enabled.
2. Refresh the Web page.
3. Check that the package name is `dsh-ollama-web` and the row is `ollama-web` (the card key is `dsh-ollama-web#ollama-web`).
4. Fall back to the patch configuration above; the host works without the card.

## Updates

**Plugins -> `dsh-ollama-web` -> Configure** (or the bundle detail page) shows an Updates section. As of 2.2.0, the bundle detail page also shows the support card. Opening this screen performs a fresh check when the last successful check is older than five minutes; **Check for updates** always checks immediately. Use **Check for updates** / **Install update**, then restart DSH (quit and reopen the desktop app) to load the new version.

- **Check:** the host reads the npm registry (fallback: npmmirror) and honours the profile's pnpm `minimumReleaseAge` only when it is explicitly set. Unset, unreadable, invalid or `0` means no age wait. A release newer than a configured age is shown as waiting instead of being installed.
- **Compatibility:** the updater compares the release's `engines.dsh` with the running DSH version (`DSH_CLIENT_VERSION` or `DSH_APP_VERSION`). A known-incompatible release is blocked; if compatibility cannot be verified, auto-update pauses while the manual Install button remains available.
- **Install:** downloads one tarball, verifies the npm SHA-512 integrity and the archive, then atomically replaces the installed package. A failed swap rolls the previous copy back.
- **Auto-update (opt-in):** off by default. When enabled, the host checks every 6 hours and installs a newer **same-major** release that supports the running DSH. Major updates require the explicit button.
- **Caveats:** a `link:` or external-directory development install is never modified. DSH 0.2.1 has no third-party update API, so the updater replaces installed files directly. The profile's `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` still record the previous version; reinstall through **Plugins** (or the CLI) if you want those records updated.

See [docs/UPDATES.md](docs/UPDATES.md) for details.

## Security

- Host plugins run in-process, outside the workspace sandbox. Review plugins before installing and pin versions.
- Search is HTTPS-only, refuses redirects, caps response/query/snippet sizes

plugins.description: CC-Switch中配置的模型可以在dsh中使用
plugins.readme_text:
# cc-switch bridge

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

Every Anthropic-compatible provider saved in the local
[cc-switch](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch) app becomes one provider route in DeepSeek
Harness, so its models appear in the model picker and switch like built-in models.

## What it reads

`~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db` (read-only), table `providers`, rows with `app_type` `claude` /
`claude-desktop`. From each row: `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`,
the model ids from `meta.stackModels` and the `ANTHROPIC_*MODEL` env keys (`model[1M]` labels keep the
id and give the context window), plus the row name as the group title. Rows are re-read every 60s and
on every model-picker open, so edits made in cc-switch show up without restarting Harness.

Rows whose `meta.apiFormat` is anything but `anthropic`, or without a base URL / credential / model,
are skipped and logged. Codex rows are imported through the built-in pi-ai adapter instead (see
Settings page); the other tool groups store their own shapes, see "Why some groups are not imported".

## What it registers

One `ctx.llm.registerAdapter()` route per provider (`ccswitch-<first 8 chars of the cc-switch id>`),
speaking Anthropic Messages (`/v1/messages`, SSE or plain JSON) and translating the reply into
Harness stream chunks: text, reasoning/thinking, tool calls, usage, finish reasons. Tool
call/result pairing is repaired before sending, because one unanswered tool call makes the upstream
reject the whole session.

## Thinking levels

The levels are not the bridge's own ladder: cc-switch already declares them per model, and the
Harness menu mirrors that declaration, so both apps offer the same choices.

- `codex` rows carry `modelCatalog.models[].reasoningLevels` (+ `defaultReasoningLevel`), which is
  what cc-switch shows for a Codex provider.
- `pi` rows carry `thinkingLevelMap`, where a `null` value means the level is not offered.
- The row with the same provider name wins; the same model id under another provider only fills in
  what that row does not say.

`none` in cc-switch is `off` here. Hosts whose endpoint cannot replay a thinking block are excluded in
`replaysWithoutThinking()` in `lib/thinking.js`, and the plugin config `thinking: false` drops every
effort menu.

## Settings page

Settings → **cc-switch-bridge** lists the tool groups your cc-switch actually has configured
(Claude Code, Claude Code Desktop, Codex, …) and imports the ones you tick. Changing the selection
re-syncs immediately — no restart — and the model picker follows.

| Group                                                          | How it is imported                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Claude Code / Claude Code Desktop / any Anthropic-format group | the bridge's own adapter, one route per provider                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Codex                                                          | handed to the built-in `dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter: one provider per cc-switch Codex row, `api` taken from the row's `wire_api` (`openai-responses` / `openai-completions`), base URL and model catalog straight from the row |
| pi / openclaw / opencode                                       | each stores its own app's config structure and the bridge has no parser for it yet, so they are listed as not importable                                                                                                  |
| gemini                                                         | this machine's row is an empty config, so there is nothing to import                                                                                                                                                      |

The Codex handoff needs no manual setup: turning it on writes a `codex` entry into the `dsh-llm-pi-ai`
plugin config in the desktop profile patch (`settingsNs: codex`) and stores each row's key in the
credential store under `CCSWITCH_CODEX_<row>`. Turning it off again removes both the routes and the
secrets the bridge wrote.

The page itself is a browser half (`client.js`) served by this package and talks to the host over
`/dsh-cc-switch/state` (GET snapshot, POST `{apps, order}` for the selection and its order). The lower
half of the page lists what is actually live, as "bridged" and "handed to pi-ai".

### Why some groups are not imported

Not a model problem and not a protocol problem: cc-switch stores one config structure per tool, and the
bridge only parses two of them — `claude` / `claude-desktop` (`env.ANTHROPIC_*`) and `codex` (TOML).

| Group      | What cc-switch actually stores                                                      | Status                                             |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `pi`       | `baseUrl` / `api` / `models[]` / `thinkingLevelMap` — pi-ai's own provider shape    | fields map almost 1:1, not implemented yet         |
| `openclaw` | `baseUrl` / `api` / `models[]`, also pi-ai-shaped                                   | not implemented yet                                |
| `opencode` | AI SDK `{npm, options, models}` (`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` / `@ai-sdk/anthropic`) | needs a small `npm → api` map, not implemented yet |
| `gemini`   | `{"env":{},"config":{}}` (empty on this machine)                                    | nothing to import                                  |

The first three would ride the same pi-ai handoff once parsed; no Harness change needed.

## Status file

`~/.dsh/dsh-cc-switch-bridge.status.json` — written after each successful sync: which routes and models
the host process actually holds. First place to look when a provider is missing from the picker.

## Ordering

The bridged and pi-ai rows can be dragged to reorder them; the saved order (`order` in the state
file) is the order the routes are registered in, so it is what the model picker shows. The
DeepSeek account/official groups stay pinned first because the picker does that itself.

## After editing this plugin

The profile installs it as a link, but the running host keeps the old module loaded: toggle the
plugin off and on in Settings → Plugins (or restart the app).

## Checks

`node tests/smoke.mjs` — SSE decoding, error mapping, tool-call repair, max_tokens clamping, model
labels, ordering, and a read of the real cc-switch database.
`node tests/client-render.mjs` — renders the settings page against a stub React, which catches the
hook-order regression that blanks the page inside the app.

plugins.description: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已装第三方插件，导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与一键安装命令串；导入先预览再按 spec 重新下载安装。Tiny modpack export/import for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-modpack · DSH 整合包

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-modpack.svg?color=cb3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-modpack)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-modpack.svg)](LICENSE)

> npm：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-modpack> · 仓库：<https://github.com/M1r0er/dsh-modpack> · MIT · DSH 插件（bundle）

像 Minecraft 的 PCL / HMCL 整合包那样管理 DSH 的第三方插件：

- **导出**：勾选本机已安装的第三方插件 → 生成一个只有清单和版本的小体积 `.dshpack.zip`（**不含插件代码、不含 `node_modules`**），同时给出一整串可直接复制执行的安装命令。
- **导入**：选择 `.dshpack.zip` 或直接粘贴命令串 → 先**预览**（已装同版本 / 版本不同 / 待安装 / 本地链接）→ 确认后再按 spec 重新下载安装；apply 前自动写 JSON 还原点。
- **发布**：把几十 KB 的 zip 发给别人，对方在「设置 → 整合包 → 导入」里预览后一键装齐。
- **本地开发也能分享**：本地 `link:` 插件只要已按同名同版本发布到 npm，导出时会自动转成 `name@version`；未发布的仍标记为不可分享。

导出的命令形如（示例，不会自动执行）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ops@0.3.0
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:owner/repo#v1.0.0
```

## 为什么不是"备份插件"

DSH 已有若干备份/迁移工具（见 [docs/RELATED.md](docs/RELATED.md)），它们通常打包**配置、凭据或本地插件目录**，体积大、偏向"整机搬家"。
整合包的定位相反：**只记录"装哪些插件、哪个版本"**，插件本体在导入时从 npm / git 重新下载。这与 PCL 整合包"只有 mods 清单、不含游戏本体"是同一种取舍：

| | 备份 / 迁移工具 | dsh-modpack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 包内容 | 配置文件、凭据、可能含本地插件源码 | 清单 + 版本 + 安装命令（可选脱敏配置） |
| 体积 | 几百 KB ~ 数 MB | 通常几 KB ~ 几十 KB |
| 适合 | 换电脑、回滚 | 发布、分享、复现一套插件组合 |
| 导入 | 覆盖配置 | 按 spec 重新下载插件，先预览再应用 |

同赛道还有一个更重的项目：[@dsh-packforge/dsh-pack-plugin](https://github.com/DSH-PackForge/dsh-pack-plugin)（`.dspack`）。它默认把 profile 配置与 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 一起打包，导入时用 pnpm 重建依赖，并绑定官方桌面端；其 README 自述 `export` / `install` 端到端仍需真实 pnpm 环境验证。dsh-modpack 选的是更轻的形态：只记录"装哪些插件、哪个版本"，并直接给出可复制的 `dsh plugin add` 命令串。完整对比见 [docs/RELATED.md](docs/RELATED.md)。

## 安装

在 DSH 里用插件管理器安装本目录（或发布后的 npm 包）：

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-modpack
```

安装后：

- **设置 → 整合包**：图形界面，勾选 / 导出 / 导入；
- **模型工具**：`modpack_list`、`modpack_export`、`modpack_inspect`、`modpack_import`，也可以让 Agent 代劳。

> 本插件依赖 DSH 内置的 `pluginManager` 与 `configEditor` 服务。老版本 DSH 若没有 `pluginManager`，导出命令串仍可用，自动安装会报"服务不可用"。

## 图形界面

设置页分两块：

1. **导出**
   - 列出当前 profile 的第三方 bundle（含版本、是否本地链接）；
   - 本地链接（`link:` / 本地路径）会按 `name@version` 查询 npm registry：已发布的自动升级为可分享项（标注「本机链接 · npm 已发布」），未发布的仍标注「不可分享」；
   - 未发布的本地插件可勾选**「内置」**：对该插件执行 `npm pack`，把插件代码以 tarball 写进整合包（见下文）；
   - 默认全选可安装项；
   - 可填名称 / 版本 / 作者 / 描述；
   - 可选"包含配置"：只收**选中插件**的 config override，疑似密钥默认替换为 `${REDACTED}`；
   - 导出后显示 zip 路径与命令块，可一键复制。
2. **导入**
   - 拖入 `.dshpack.zip`，或粘贴命令串；
   - 预览表逐条列出 `spec` 与状态 `installed-same / installed-different / missing / local / unknown`，内置条目带「内置」标记；
   - 点"应用安装"需二次确认；含内置插件时会额外提示"将执行包内第三方代码"；执行完显示每一步结果、还原点路径；需要重启的改动会单独提示。

## 命令行 / Agent 工具

```jsonc
// 列出可导出的插件
{ "tool": "modpack_list" }

// 导出（不写 zip，只拿命令串）
{ "tool": "modpack_export", "writeArchive": false, "include": ["dsh-ops", "dsh-context"] }

// 导出为 zip（默认写到 ~/.dsh/modpacks）
{ "tool": "modpack_export", "name": "我的整合包", "version": "1.0.0" }

// 把未发布 npm 的本地插件“内置”进包（对每个插件执行 npm pack）
{ "tool": "modpack_export", "include": ["dsh-local-x", "dsh-ops"], "embed": ["dsh-local-x"] }

// 导入预览（默认 apply=false，绝不安装）
{ "tool": "modpack_import", "path": "D:/packs/我的整合包-1.0.0.dshpack.zip" }

// 确认后应用；包里含内置插件时必须显式 allowEmbedded
{ "tool": "modpack_import", "path": "…", "apply": true, "allowEmbedded": true }
```

`modpack_import` 的安装动作走 `pluginManager.installBundle(spec, { saveExact: true })`，**不执行 shell，也不执行粘贴文本里的任何命令**——命令串只被解析成 spec。

## 内置插件（随包代码，可选）

有些插件只在本机开发、不打算发布 npm，仍想分享给朋友。此时可在导出面板勾选该插件的**「内置」**：

1. 对插件的本机目录执行 `pnpm pack`（尊重 `package.json` 的 `files` / `.npmignore`，排除 `node_modules`）；
2. 扫描包内文件名，含 `.env`、`config.toml`、`credentials.*`、私钥等疑似凭据时**拒绝内置**；
3. 把 tarball 写入 zip 的 `embedded/<name>-<version>.tgz`，并在 `dshpack.json` 记录 `sha256` 与 `size`；
4. 导入时校验 sha256/size 后落到 `~/.dsh/modpacks/embedded/`，再交给 `pluginManager.installBundle(tarball)` 安装（走 DSH 自己的 pnpm 通道）。

> ⚠️ 内置 = 把第三方代码装进 profile。只分享/导入你信任的来源；导入应用前会再次确认，且必须显式 `allowEmbedded: true`（界面已在确认框里代填）。
>
> 内置插件若还有未发布的 npm 依赖，导入时 pnpm 会解析失败；v1 只保证“依赖都能从 registry 解析”的插件可内置。

`.dshpack.zip` 是一个普通 zip，内含：

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `dshpack.json` | 清单：format/version、插件列表（name、version、spec、kind、bundle 行）、安装命令、可选 config、内置 tarball 的 sha256/size |
| `embedded/*.tgz` | 仅在选择“内置”时出现：随包携带的插件 tarball |
| `install.ps1` / `install.sh` | 与清单一致的安装命令脚本（内置插件不产生命令） |
| `README.md` | 人类可读的说明 |

`dshpack.json` 关键字段见 [API.md](API.md)；`format` 固定为 `dsh-modpack`，当前 `formatVersion` 为 **2**（1 为无内置的旧格式，仍可导入）。导入时会校验格式版本，未来格式升级会给出明确提示。

## 安全

- 导出默认**从不安装**任何东西；列表会为本地链接插件向 npm registry 做一次只读版本查询（2s 超时，失败按未发布处理），可用 `DSH_MODPACK_REGISTRY_CHECK=off` 关闭。
- 导入默认只预览；`apply:true` 前会写 `<outDir>/backups/before-import-<时间>.json`。
- 默认包内不写插件代码；只有显式“内置”才会写入 tarball，并记录 sha256/size，导入时校验后才安装。
- `config` 默认不导出，导出时会剔除密钥键与 `sk-` / `ghp_` / `xoxb-` 等明文 token。
- 本地链接插件（`link:` / 本地路径）只有**同名同版本已发布到 npm** 时才按 `name@version` 导出；否则可显式内置或标记不可分享，不会把别人的本地路径当成可下载 spec。
- 本插件的 HTTP 路由与 GUI 同源（`/modpack/*`），没有额外的跨域入口。

## 已知限制

- 只处理 **bundle**（`dsh.profile.bundles` / `package.json` 依赖）；随 DSH 发行的 installation 内置 bundle 不导出。
- 安装依赖目标机器能访问 npm / git，企业内网需要自行配置 registry。
- 版本对比是字符串精确比较；`name@latest` 这类浮动 spec 只能判断"已安装/未安装"。
- 不支持 zip64 / 加密 zip；整合包超过 32 MiB 会被拒绝（正常只有几 KB）。
- 配置导入（`withConfig` / 界面勾选）目前按 `patchId` 匹配本机行；行 id 被上游插件改名时会跳过并给出 reason。
- 内置插件版本随包冻结、不会自动更新；升级需重新导出/导入。内置依赖若未发布到 registry，pnpm 安装会失败。
- 内置 tarball 上限：单个 12 MiB、整体 24 MiB；超过会拒绝导出。

## 开发

```sh
node --check index.js
node tests/zip.test.mjs
node tests/pack.test.mjs
node tests/host.test.mjs   # 用 mock Cordis 服务跑导出→预览→apply 全链路
```

- `lib/zip.mjs`：零依赖 zip 读写（store/deflate、CRC32、UTF-8 文件名）。
- `lib/pack.mjs`：清单构建/校验、spec 分类、命令解析、密钥剔除、diff。
- `index.js`：Host 半，接 `pluginManager` / `configEditor`，注册工具与 `/modpack/*` 路由。
- `client.js`：设置页，注册到 `settings.section`。

## 验证状态

- **2026-10-20 v0.2.0 内置插件**：真实 `pnpm pack` 冒烟通过——把 `dsh-workspace-gate` 目录打成 41.9 KiB tarball 写入 zip，清单为 `formatVersion: 2`、记录 sha256/size；导入端 mock 验证了 sha256 不符会拒绝、未带 `allowEmbedded` 会拒绝、内置 tarball 落到稳定目录后调用 `installBundle(tarball)`。
- **2026-10-20 v0.1.2 修复**：Host 已把「本地链接但 npm 同版本已发布」的插件升级为可分享项，但 Client 的勾选判定仍残留 `local === true → 不可选`，导致这类插件显示「本机链接 · npm 已发布」却无法勾选。现已改为以 `installable` / `published` 为准，并补了回归测试（`dsh-workspace-gate`、`dsh-inkvault` 这类插件可直接勾选导出）。
- **2026-10-19 真机**（DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / Windows）：重启后设置页已注册（`settings.section`，`id=modpack`，order 45，active）；`modpack_list` 读到 15 个第三方插件；`modpack_export` 生成 5.0 KiB 整合包 / 13 条安装命令（2 个本地链接自动跳过）；`modpack_inspect` 预览结果为 13 已装同版本 + 2 本地链接跳过。
- **离线**：22 项测试通过（zip 往返/CRC、命令解析、密钥剔除、本地链接升级、内置清单校验、mock Cordis 全链路、client 勾选判定），详见 [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app: QR pairing, DSH on your phone, answer approvals from notifications.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Mobile — host plugin for DeepSeek Harness

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

`@kinocode/dsh-mobile` is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app. It lets you:

- Pair your phone by scanning a QR code in the DSH sidebar.
- Use the regular DSH web UI on your phone through an HTTPS gateway running on your computer.
- Answer approval requests and agent questions from notifications in the live desktop session (the first answer from any device wins).
- Receive a notification when a watched session finishes its turn.

The Android app is distributed separately and is not part of this repository. This is an unofficial project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`. The range is pinned because the plugin relies on internal DSH Gateway APIs that are not yet stable.
- The DSH web server (`webserver` service), included with DSH Desktop.
- Node.js 22.4 or later (the runtime bundled with DSH Desktop works).
- Phone and computer on the same network, or both on [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com/).
- For notifications: a relay server (see [Notifications and the relay](#notifications-and-the-relay)).

## Install

Add `@kinocode/dsh-mobile` on the DSH Plugins page, or run:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @kinocode/dsh-mobile
```

Restart DSH. The log should show `[mobile-bridge] gateway listening {"origins":[...]}`.

## Pair a phone

1. Click **スマホを接続** ("Connect phone") at the bottom of the DSH sidebar.
2. In the app, tap **QR を読み取る** ("Scan QR") and scan the code. If you do not have a camera, use **リンクをコピー** ("Copy link") and paste the link into the app.
3. The code is single-use and expires after 5 minutes. Click **新しい QR** ("New QR") to generate another.

The panel also lists paired phones and lets you remove them. Removing a phone revokes its access immediately. The panel is currently available only in Japanese.

On the phone, the DSH sidebar is hidden so the conversation gets the full width. The round button at the top left opens it over the conversation; picking a session or tapping outside closes it. Desktop-only buttons are hidden.

When you add a workspace on the phone, the computer's folders are listed on the phone instead of opening a folder dialog on the computer. Browse to a folder or type its path, then tap **このフォルダを使う** ("Use this folder").

The right sidebar (files, preview, changes review, browser, terminal) opens full screen on the phone. Buttons that open an app or Finder on the computer are hidden on the phone; the file preview offers **スマホに保存** ("Save to phone") instead, which saves to the phone's Downloads. If the page stays blank after DSH restarts, it reloads by itself.

The round buttons at the top left (sidebar) and top right (right sidebar) can be moved anywhere: long-press one, then drag it.

In DSH's built-in browser (the right sidebar's Browser), words that are not an address are searched: Google on the desktop, Bing on the phone. The phone can only show pages that allow being framed (Google and others refuse), so ↗ (Open in system browser) opens the page in Chrome.

## Configuration

All fields are optional. Add them to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A profile patch replaces the plugin's entire configuration, so include every field you want to keep.

```yaml
- id: mobile-bridge
  config:
    relayUrl: https://relay.example.com
    relayEnrollToken: '...'
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `relayUrl` | `''` (off) | Relay used for notifications and answering from them. |
| `relayEnrollToken` | `''` | Token for a relay that only accepts known computers. |
| `gatewayEnabled` | `true` | Run the HTTPS gateway for phones. |
| `gatewayPort` | `3543` | Gateway port (1024–65535). |
| `gatewayHosts` | detected | IPv4 addresses to listen on. Only private addresses are accepted (see below). |
| `hostLabel` | computer name | Name shown on the phone. |
| `previewMaxChars` | `400` | Longest command preview shown in the app (50–4000). |
| `stateDir` | `$DSH_HOME/mobile-bridge` | Absolute path for host identity, paired devices, and certificates. `$DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`. |

The configuration ID `mobile-bridge` and log name `dsh-mobile-bridge` are kept for compatibility with earlier versions.

## How it works

- **Gateway.** The HTTPS server listens only on private IPv4 addresses: `10/8`, `172.16/12`, `192.168/16`, and Tailscale's `100.64/10`. Certificates come from a CA created by the plugin. The QR code contains the CA fingerprint, so the app trusts only that CA for this computer.
- **Pairing.** The app generates an ECDSA P-256 key in the Android Keystore and registers the public key using the one-time code.
- **Control requests.** Requests for the pending list, answers, and settings are signed with the device key. The plugin verifies the signature, a timestamp (±5 minutes), and a nonce to prevent replay attacks.
- **DSH screen.** After pairing, the app receives a 12-hour gateway session signed with a secret that never leaves the computer. Removing the device revokes it immediately. The gateway logs in to the local DSH web server directly; the phone never receives DSH's own login.
- **Live session.** The plugin connects to the DSH Gateway event stream in-process as an owner client, like an additional GUI window. Because it registers no approval listener, it cannot take requests away from the desktop or bypass it. The Gateway accepts the first answer submitted and closes the prompt everywhere else.
- **Desktop panel.** The sidebar panel uses owner-only DSH API routes (`/api/dsh-mobile-bridge/*`).

## Notifications and the relay

A phone on mobile data cannot reach the gateway directly, so notifications go through a relay. The plugin maintains an outbound WebSocket to it. The relay delivers push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging and forwards the phone's signed requests to your computer. It cannot create those signatures, and it never handles the DSH screen or DSH's login.

No public relay is provided. Without one, all features except notifications work as long as the phone can reach the computer directly.

What the relay can read:

- **Push messages.** By default: the session title, the tool name or question heading, up to three answer options, status, and internal IDs. If you turn on **ロック画面にコマンド全文を表示** ("Show full command on the lock screen") in the app, the relay also sees the command preview or full question (up to 400 characters) and the first 200 characters of the agent's last reply when a turn ends.
- **Requests sent through the relay.** Traffic is encrypted between each endpoint and the relay, but not end-to-end. When the phone routes requests through the relay, the relay can read the pending list (full command preview, reason, questions), the session list (titles and working directories), and your answers, including free-text replies.

Only use a relay you run yourself or trust.

On the lock screen, Android displays a short public summary unless the phone is set to show sensitive content. When DSH quits normally, the plugin tries to withdraw open notifications (waiting up to 3 seconds). If DSH crashes, the app removes stale notifications the next time it loads the pending list.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Check |
|---|---|
| The phone cannot connect | Are both devices on the same network or on Tailscale? Is a firewall blocking port 3543? If the computer's IP address changed, generate a new QR code. |
| "The certificate does not match the QR code" | The code is from another computer, or the gateway CA was recreated. Generate a new QR code. |
| No notifications | Are notifications enabled on the phone? Is `relayUrl` set, and does the DSH log show `relay connected`? Does the session's permission preset ask for approval? ("Full access" never does.) |
| The DSH screen is blank after a DSH restart | Close and reopen the app once DSH has finished starting. |

## Security

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) to report a vulnerability.

## Development

```bash
npm test
```

The tests use Node's built-in test runner and require no network access or external dependencies.

## License

[MIT](LICEN

# Followup Prompt English | [中文](README.zh.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-followup-prompt)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-followup-prompt) [![CI](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) > Predicts your next message in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Press Tab to use it; it never sends by itself. After each reply, the plugin guesses what you are most likely to say next and shows it as gray text inside the empty composer. Press **Tab** to turn it into an editable draft, or just start typing and it disappears. - **Unobtrusive**: appears only when the composer is empty; failures and timeouts show nothing and never raise an error. - **You stay in control**: a prediction is only a draft. You always send it yourself. - **Works out of the box**: uses the current session's model by default, with no extra dependencies or services. ## Contents - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Upgrade and uninstall](#upgrade-and-uninstall) - [Development](#development) ## Installation Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0 <0.3.0` (verified on 0.2.1-rc.2) with at least one model configured. **Harness Desktop (Windows, macOS)** 1. In the sidebar, open **Plugins** → **Add plugin**. 2. Enter `dsh-followup-prompt` as the **Package name or address**. In mainland China, set **Registry** to **Mainland China mirror**. 3. Click **Install**, then **Enable now**, and reload the page. If you are told to restart DSH, quit Harness completely and open it again. If npm is unreachable, step 2 also accepts the full path of a `dsh-followup-prompt-.tgz` downloaded from [Releases](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/releases). **Harness Web (Windows, macOS, Linux)** Requires Node.js `22.19` or later and pnpm. ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-followup-prompt npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 web ``` > [!NOTE] > Do not install from the source directory (entering this repository's path as the package address). A directory install cannot find the dependencies that ship with Harness, so the plugin fails to load. To build locally, run `pnpm pack` in this repository and install the resulting `.tgz`. **Verify the installation**: ask a question, wait for the reply to finish, and leave the composer empty. Gray prediction text appears in the composer; press Tab and the text moves into the composer **without being sent**. If no prediction appears, see the [FAQ](#faq). ## Usage When a reply finishes and the composer is empty, the prediction appears where the placeholder would be, with a `Tab to accept` hint on the right. | Action | Effect | |---|---| | **Tab** | The prediction becomes a draft in the composer with the cursor at the end, ready to edit | | **Esc** or click × | Closes this prediction; it does not come back for this turn | | Start typing or composing with an input method | The prediction hides; once the composer is cleared, a prediction that was already generated reappears | | Start a new turn or switch sessions | The prediction hides | Reopening a finished session also shows the prediction for its last turn. ## How it works **When the model is called**: only while you are looking at a session whose turn has finished and the composer is empty. The result stays in memory until the next turn starts, so viewing it again is not billed again. Interrupted or failed turns, empty sessions, and subagent sessions are never predicted for. With `prefetchOnTurnEnd` on, a prediction is generated as soon as a turn ends, whether or not you are looking. **What the model receives**: a "condensed transcript". Each turn keeps only your message and the visible text of the model's reply; thinking, tool calls, tool output, and the main conversation's system prompt are left out. Each turn appends just one pair of messages at the end, so the provider's prefix cache builds up turn after turn and most input tokens are billed at the cached rate. **Cost**: every prediction is an ordinary model request billed by your provider. Turn it off with `enabled`, switch to a cheaper model with `provider` / `model`, or limit the transcript length with `maxTurns`. **Privacy** - Data goes only to the current session's model, or to the model you set with `provider` / `model`. Nothing is reported to any third party. - Predictions live in memory only. They are never written to the session log or to disk, and are gone after a restart. - Logs record metadata only (latency, token counts, outcome), never conversation content. - There is no server-side content moderation. Predictions that look like secrets are dropped locally, and you always send a prediction yourself. ## Configuration On the **Plugins** page, find **Followup Prompt** in the **Installed** list and click its configure button. You can also edit this plugin's `config` in a profile patch directly. > [!IMPORTANT] > When editing a patch directly, `config` is replaced as a whole, not merged. Even to change one field, write out every field; use this package's [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) as a reference. | Field | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. When off, no model requests are made. | | `provider` / `model` | `''` / `''` | The model used for predictions; both must be set together. Leave empty to use the current session's model. | | `reasoningEffort` | `'low'` | One of `''`, `off`, `low`, `high`, `max`. `''` uses the model's default; the session's own setting is never inherited. | | `maxTokens` | `8192` | Output token limit, reasoning tokens included. Actual output is usually short; the default leaves room for thinking. | | `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Timeout for one prediction, 2–30 seconds. | | `maxTurns` | `0` | Keep at most the last N turns of the condensed transcript; `0` keeps them all. | | `prefetchOnTurnEnd` | `false` | Generate as soon as a turn ends, even for sessions you are not looking at. Incurs cost for every active session. | | `prompt` | `''` | Advanced: replaces the built-in prediction instruction. | ## FAQ
No prediction ever appears - Check that `enabled` is `true`. - With non-DeepSeek models, `reasoningEffort: 'low'` may not be supported; change it to `''`. - A prediction is given up when the model takes longer than `timeoutMs`; try a faster model or a lower `reasoningEffort`. - Predictions are not shown while the composer contains text or attachments.
Tab does nothing While the slash-command menu or another popup menu is open, Tab belongs to the menu. Close the menu and press Tab again.
The prediction is misaligned Where the prediction is drawn depends on the internal structure of the Harness composer, which can shift after a Harness upgrade. Please open an issue; until it is fixed, set `enabled` to `false` to turn the plugin off.
An older version was installed Harness installs plugins with pnpm, which by default holds back versions published very recently (`minimumReleaseAge`) and installs the previous version instead; the install result shows the version actually installed. Wait a while, then reinstall following the [upgrade](#upgrade-and-uninstall) steps.
## Upgrade and uninstall **Harness Desktop**: on the **Plugins** page, find **Followup Prompt** in the **Installed** list and click **Uninstall**. To upgrade, uninstall first, then install again following [Installation](#installation). **Harness Web**: ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-followup-prompt@latest # upgrade npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web remove dsh-followup-prompt # uninstall ``` Reload the page afterwards, and restart Harness if needed. plugins.description: Install Z.AI MCP servers into DeepSeek Harness: skill, bootstrap and agent preset.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zai-mcp

A DeepSeek Harness **user skill** for connecting the Z.AI hosted MCP servers
(ZRead, Vision, Web Reader) to a DSH profile — and, more generally, for adding,
porting and debugging any MCP server:

- one `insert` row with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` in the profile's
  `cordis.patch.yml`, for `stdio`, `streamable-http` and `sse` transports;
- mapping from other clients (Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor/VS Code, local
  Go/Python MCP servers, hosted vendors);
- the only correct secret seam: `!!js` environment expressions plus
  `$DSH_HOME/.env` (mode 600) — never a literal token in the config;
- verification (`--dump-config`, an MCP `initialize` probe, restart) and the
  pitfalls seen in practice.

The worked Z.AI example (ZRead, Vision, Web Reader) is in
[`references/zai-mcp.md`](references/zai-mcp.md).

## Repository layout

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | the skill itself (frontmatter + procedure), symlinked into `~/.dsh/skills/` |
| `references/zai-mcp.md` | the worked configuration: key source, all four servers, the agent-preset gate, verification, troubleshooting |
| `templates/standard-0.2.1-rc.2.plugins.yml` | the standard agent preset's plugin list, copied verbatim from DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 |
| `templates/zai-mcp-rows.yml` | the four `mcp-client` rows appended to that list |
| `bin/install.mjs` | zero-dependency installer + verifier (`--dry-run`, `--check`, `--global`, `--force`, `--standard`) |
| `bootstrap.sh` | one-command end-to-end setup (skill link, key, preset, verify, optional `--restart`) |
| `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` | agent entry points (installation target: DeepSeek Harness) |

## Handing the link to an agent

The repository is written to be driven by an AI agent, whichever harness it runs
in:

- [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) is the entry point: the target is always DeepSeek
  Harness, and the agent may run inside or outside DSH; the file carries the
  preconditions, the bootstrap command, the key/restart rules and the report
  format;
- [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) points Claude Code at the same file;
- every step is idempotent and self-verifying, so an agent can rerun it after a
  failure without corrupting the profile.

## One-command setup on a new machine

Install and launch DeepSeek Harness once, then paste the link:

```sh
git clone git@github.com:bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp.git ~/src/github.com/bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp \
  && ~/src/github.com/bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp/bootstrap.sh --restart
```

`bootstrap.sh` does everything by itself:

1. picks node (the system one or the runtime bundled with the app);
2. pulls the latest checkout (skipped when offline / the private remote refuses);
3. links the skill into `~/.dsh/skills/dsh-zai-mcp`;
4. provisions `ZAI_API_KEY` in `~/.dsh/.env` — from the credential store of the
   already configured Z.AI provider, `--key`, or the environment — and fails with
   the console link when no source exists;
5. writes the `preset-zai` agent preset through `bin/install.mjs` (idempotent
   managed block between markers);
6. verifies the result: env key, patch rows, and a `--dump-config` of a throwaway
   profile copy;
7. with `--restart`, quits and reopens the app so the new `.env` and preset load.

Afterwards create a new chat, pick the **Z.AI (GLM)** preset and choose a GLM
model in that session; Standard/Creator sessions never mount the servers.

If the Z.AI provider is not configured in DSH yet, either configure it there or
run `./bootstrap.sh --key <token>` with a key from
[z.ai → API Keys → Personal Coding Plan](https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list).

Manual equivalent (same steps, no bootstrap):

```sh
ln -s "$PWD" ~/.dsh/skills/dsh-zai-mcp
printf "ZAI_API_KEY='%s'\n" "$KEY" >> ~/.dsh/.env && chmod 600 ~/.dsh/.env
node bin/install.mjs
node bin/install.mjs --check
```

### Options

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | print the managed block, write nothing |
| `--check` | verify the current state (env, patch, composed profile); write nothing and exit 1 on problems |
| `--global` | mount the four rows at profile level instead of inside the preset |
| `--prune-global` | when installing the preset, remove a profile-level mount left by an earlier setup |
| `--force` | rewrite the managed block even when it already exists |
| `--dsh-home PATH` / `--profile NAME` | target another Harness home or profile |
| `--npx PATH` | absolute npx used by the stdio vision row (default: volta/homebrew probe) |
| `--standard FILE` | build from another DSH version's `presets/standard.patch.yml` instead of the committed snapshot |

Updating the preset after a DSH upgrade:

```sh
# extract the new standard preset from the installed app (or copy it from a source checkout)
npx asar extract-file "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar" \
  node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-bundle-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml > /tmp/standard.patch.yml
node bin/install.mjs --standard /tmp/standard.patch.yml --force
node bin/install.mjs --check
```

## Install

The skill is a plain directory bundle: `SKILL.md` with YAML frontmatter plus
optional `references/`. DSH's filesystem skill provider discovers it under the
user root (`~/.dsh/skills`), the project root (`<repo>/.dsh/skills`) or
`<repo>/.agents/skills`.

```sh
git clone git@github.com:bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp.git ~/src/github.com/bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp
ln -s ~/src/github.com/bosenok/dsh-zai-mcp ~/.dsh/skills/dsh-zai-mcp
```

A symlink keeps the checkout as the single source of truth: editing `SKILL.md`
here is picked up by the next skill catalog, no restart needed.

## Verify

```sh
ls -l ~/.dsh/skills/dsh-zai-mcp            # -> the checkout
sed -n '1,6p' ~/.dsh/skills/mcp-setup/SKILL.md
```

In a DSH session the skill appears in the catalog as `dsh-zai-mcp`.

plugins.description: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）网页能力插件，以 ctx.web 提供方形式注册，接入keenable
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-keenable

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）网页能力插件，以 `ctx.web` 提供方形式注册，结构和官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-exa` 一致，同时提供**搜索**和**抓取**两个能力。

> a dsh web-capability plugin registering a search and a fetch provider into the `ctx.web` seam, mirroring the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-exa`.

> **版本要求**：需要 dsh ≥ 0.2.1-rc.2——配置热更新（改配置不重启）与插件管理页内的配置面板都依赖该版本的 loader 与客户端组件。

| 能力 | 后端 | 密钥 |
|---|---|---|
| `web_search` + `web_fetch` | Keenable `/v1/search`、`/v1/fetch` | 可无密钥（公共端点限流），有密钥更好：配置 `apiKey`、凭据服务或 `$KEENABLE_API_KEY` |

姊妹插件（TinyFish 后端）在独立仓库 [dsh-web-search-tinyfish](https://github.com/lliangworld/dsh-web-search-tinyfish)。两个插件互相独立、版本各自管理，可以只装其中一个，也可以两个都装。

## 安装

命令里的 `--profile <name>` 决定插件装进哪个 profile：`web`（Web GUI）或 `desktop`（桌面客户端）。**两个 profile 互相独立**（各有各的 manifest 和 lockfile），装了 web 不会自动装到 desktop，需要的话两边分别执行。

```powershell
# web profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lliangworld/dsh-web-search-keenable

# desktop profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lliangworld/dsh-web-search-keenable
```

`github:用户名/仓库名` 也可以写成完整仓库地址 `https://github.com/lliangworld/dsh-web-search-keenable`。

## 升级

插件以分支 spec 安装，升级即让 pnpm 重新解析到仓库 main 的最新提交：

```powershell
# 更新插件（web profile）
dsh plugin --profile web update @lliangworld/dsh-web-search-keenable

# desktop profile 同理
dsh plugin --profile desktop update @lliangworld/dsh-web-search-keenable
```

web 与 desktop 需要各自执行升级。更新后的代码在**下次启动 Harness 时生效**。

> **不要用重跑 `add` 的方式升级**：spec 未变化时 pnpm 会跳过重新解析，升级请用 `update`。固定到历史版本、tag 安装等进阶用法见 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。

## 固定使用哪个提供方

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中指定，搜索和抓取可以分别选择（混搭亦可）：

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: keenable   # 或 tinyfish
    fetchProvider: keenable    # 或 tinyfish
```

不指定的情况下，`ctx.web` 会自动选用各自能力下已注册且可用的提供方。

## 配置热更新

插件的全部配置字段都是易变的（volatile）：在 profile 配置中修改任意字段——端点、检索模式、数量上限、过滤条件、密钥引用等——**下一次调用即生效**，无需重启 Harness（loader 会把新值提交进运行中的插件，而不是重启它）。API 密钥按操作解析：配置字面量 `apiKey` → 凭据服务（`KEENABLE_API_KEY` 引用）→ 启动环境变量，任一提供均可。各字段完整说明见 [docs/PACKAGE.md](docs/PACKAGE.md)（英文）与 [docs/PACKAGE.zh.md](docs/PACKAGE.zh.md)（中文）。

## 在插件管理页配置（1.0.5 起）

本插件带浏览器端设置卡：插件管理页中对应 bundle 的**行标题即配置入口**，点击进入行的配置页——API 密钥经凭据服务管理（不写入设置文件），除 `apiKeyEnv` 外的全部字段均可编辑（提示文字标注默认值、覆盖状态与恢复默认；不常用字段收在默认折叠的“高级设置”组内），保存后下一次调用即生效。配置入口仅在插件加载后出现。

## 目录结构

```text
.
├── index.js            # 插件入口：配置模式、凭据解析、提供方注册，两个提供方的完整实现（单文件、无需构建）
├── client.js           # 浏览器端设置卡（插件管理页配置入口，手写 __ModuleLoader__ factory，无构建步骤）
├── cordis.patch.yml    # loader patch：向 web seam insert 本插件
├── icon.svg
├── locale/             # en.json / zh.json
├── docs/
│   ├── PACKAGE.md      # 包参考文档（英文）：配置字段与行为完整说明
│   └── PACKAGE.zh.md   # 包参考文档（中文）
├── AGENTS.md           # 开发与发布流程（面向开发者/编码代理）
├── LICENSE             # MIT
├── README.md           # 本文件：使用说明
└── package.json        # 本仓库即一个 dsh bundle 包
```

纯 ESM、无构建步骤。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: WorkBuddy 模型接入与每日签到合一的 DeepSeek Harness 插件 (cn models + daily check-in in one plugin)
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Buddy Suite

> **本项目已停止维护并归档，`0.1.3-final` 是最终版本。**
>
> **停更定性**：经真机实测，非官方客户端接入 WorkBuddy 模型的方案在 WorkBuddy 2026-10-20 起的限制下**已不可行**；本项目因此走到当前生命末尾，以 `0.1.3-final` 作为归档版本收尾。**本插件不声称可用，也不推荐他人继续沿用此方案**；若需接入 WorkBuddy 模型，请使用官方 WorkBuddy 客户端。
>
> **背景与边界**：2026 年 10 月 20 日起，WorkBuddy 开始限制非官方客户端发出的请求；上游依赖 [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 已停止维护，并计划于 2026 年 10 月 22 日下线（以其公告原文为准）。本项目同样尊重这一边界，不再继续适配 WorkBuddy 私有协议；不再处理新功能请求与 PR，不再提供更新、兼容性修复及问题支持。
>
> **历史记录（非能力承诺）**：在 upstream 停更前，本插件曾先行补齐其 issue 中记录的若干能力与修复——错误诊断（#199）、上下文 / 推理档位控制（#186 / #96）、可见性开关（#181 / #168）、积分展示（#183）、单测 172 → 360（#165）、四路发布分发（#180 / #176 / #175 / #160 / #158）、凭据健壮性与 Windows「回收 PID」保护，以及本次收尾的 T1 优雅降级 / T2 健康路由 / T4 凭证隔离。以上仅供了解来龙去脉，不构成「该方案仍可用」的暗示。
>
> **致谢**：感谢一路使用的用户。代码与文档保留原样，供参考与个人学习研究；不保证在任何 WorkBuddy / DeepSeek Harness 版本上继续工作，也不推荐继续使用。支持范围见 [`COMPATIBILITY.md`](./COMPATIBILITY.md)。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/chenpiyanghappy/dsh-buddy-suite)

中文 | [English](./README.en.md)

> **状态**：最终版本 `0.1.3-final`（已归档）— [GitHub](https://github.com/chenpiyanghappy/dsh-buddy-suite) · [CNB](https://cnb.cool/chenpiyanghappy/dsh-buddy-suite) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-buddy-suite)

> 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并自动完成每日签到。**模型接入同时覆盖国内版（WorkBuddy）与国际版（WorkBuddy AI）两套账号**；签到面向本机全部国内版账号。

`dsh-buddy-suite`（插件节点 id `llm-workbuddy-suite`，provider `workbuddy-suite` / `workbuddy-ai-suite`）是一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 cordis 插件，把原本需要两个独立流程才能做完的事合并到一起：

1. **模型接入**：通过本机 loopback 的 OpenAI 兼容 shim，把 WorkBuddy 桌面客户端里的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。支持 `cn` / `global` 两个区，覆盖流式对话、工具调用、推理力度档位、积分余额与过期预警。
2. **每日签到**：在 DeepSeek Harness 启动与会话面板交互时，自动为所有本机 WorkBuddy 国内版账号完成每日签到（CN-only；国际账号会被上游私有端点拒绝）。签到幂等、失败重试、跨午夜惰性滚动。

两半只共用一个**凭证解密模块**（用 App 自带的 Electron 解密本机 at-rest 凭证），彼此独立、任一半失败都不影响另一半。

> **是的，它是一个替代品，不是补充品。** 装本插件即可，**不要再装** [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 或 [`dsh-buddy-checkin`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-buddy-checkin)——它们分别是本插件的两半，签到这部分正是由本插件接手的。`dsh-buddy-checkin` 的 `0.4.1`（2026-10-19）已支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 / rc.2，装上不会被拒绝安装；但它只管签到，模型接入仍需另装 connect，两边功能重复。

---

## 截图

每日签到 —— 启动时自动完成签到，toast 直接报出「已签到 +100 积分」与剩余积分：

![每日签到：已签到 +100 积分与剩余积分](assets/screenshot-checkin-panel.png)

插件卡片 —— 「输入框显示」两个独立开关（余额速览 / 推理档位入口，可分别关闭），下方是推理档位检测与「一键探测未完成（12 个）」：

## 功能要点

- **模型接入（upstream / shim / adapter）**
  - 每个变体（`workbuddy-suite` 国内 / `workbuddy-ai-suite` 国际）注册一个 provider。带 `-suite` 后缀是为了在「误装两个插件」时不静默覆盖对方，正常使用只有本插件时不影响任何行为。
  - 本机起一个 loopback 的 OpenAI 兼容接口，把 WorkBuddy 上游协议包装后交给 DeepSeek Harness 的 `llm-pi-ai` 扩展点调用；流式、工具调用、上下文压缩、权限均留在宿主侧。
  - 模型目录单飞抓取、按账号显隐、reasoning 档位探测、心跳文件给 CLI 看状态。
  - 积分过期按 24h / 3d / 7d 分桶预警，避免「500 积分其实是 1 小时后过期」的坑。
- **每日签到（checkin）**
  - 扫 `CodeBuddyExtension/Data/Public/auth` 发现本机所有账号；明文 / at-rest key 双路解密凭证。
  - 仅在启动 + 面板交互时签（上游只认「今天」，定时任务纯属浪费请求）。
  - 已签 / 已领过的账号重启不再重复请求；失败项单独重试。
- **推理档位探测（reasoning levels）**
  - 逐模型探测该模型接受哪些推理档位；判定为不可调档位时回落到目录声明的默认档位，而不是笼统的「检测未完成」。
  - **一键批量探测**：把还没探测过的模型一次跑完（卡片上显示剩余个数），执行前先按模型档位数**报价**再确认，避免一次批量探测悄悄吃掉大笔积分。
  - 探测未完成时显示**具体原因**（被拒的是哪个参数、上游回了什么），不是一个无信息的死路。
  - 探测结果按账号与 catalog 行指纹记账：目录行一变就重新探测，与上游插件**各存各的**，互不作废。
- **安全边界**
  - 同源路由只收 loopback 请求（Host / Origin 双校验防 DNS 重绑定）。
  - 跨给浏览器的字段全部过滤 token（JWT 与 `token=xxx` 正则打码）。
  - 凭证只在本机解密，不离开设备。

## 输入框显示开关

输入框右侧会显示两项信息：**余额速览**（当前账号剩余积分）和**推理档位入口**。

它们对普通用户有用，但有两类人会被打扰：已经用别的插件显示余额的人（同一个数字看两遍），以及经常在多个供应商之间切换的人（同样的控件出现两套）。

在插件卡片（`设置 → 插件 → 本插件`）的「状态」页里有「输入框显示」一节，两个勾选框可以分别关掉它们：

| 开关 | 关掉后 |
|---|---|
| 显示余额速览 | 隐藏积分数字**和**旁边的 ↻ 刷新按钮（没有数字时刷新按钮没有意义） |
| 显示推理档位入口 | 隐藏推理档位图标及其全部气泡提示 |

两者**默认都开启**——不打开的普通用户能看到功能，介意的人可以自己关。两项独立，关一个不影响另一个。

偏好保存在 `$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-ui-preferences.json`，**按机器保存而不是按账号**：切换账号不会把已关掉的显示项重新打开。文件缺失或损坏时回退为「全部显示」。

> 当前 DSH 0.2.x 已移除插件的 settings section API，所以这个开关无法注册成宿主设置项，只能由插件自管理的文件承载。

# dsh-webdav-sync

用 WebDAV 在多台电脑之间同步 DSH 的配置。备份在**离开本机之前**就用口令封好（AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-SHA256，600000 轮），所以服务器上自始至终只有一个密文文件 —— 它看不到你的模型目录、插件清单、API 密钥，也看不到密钥属于哪个供应商。

同步的内容是 DSH profile 里的这几样：

| 份（`Part`） | 取自 | 中文名 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `models` | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `llm-pi-ai` 行 | 模型供应商与模型 |
| `patch` | `cordis.patch.yml` 里其余的 loader 行（MCP、权限预设、UI 设置、insert 块……） | 其余 profile 配置 |
| `plugins` | `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` | 已安装插件 |
| `dirs` | 你在「同步内容」里**选择**的目录（profile 之外的绝对路径） | 附加目录 |
| `keys` | DSH 凭据服务里、被上面几份点名的那些 API 密钥 | API 密钥 |

模型配置按 Loader 的覆盖顺序取**最后一个带 `config` 的适用 `llm-pi-ai` 行**；后面的 `disabled` 等元数据行不遮蔽前面的配置。同步保留该配置中 `providers` 的键序和显式 `models` 数组的顺序。宿主界面另有账号/官方供应商优先、内置目录顺序等展示规则；纯 provider 重排也可能要重启 DSH 才反映到运行中的列表。未显式配置模型列表时，列表来自各自宿主的内置目录，目录版本不同仍可能显示不同顺序（[0065](docs/decisions/0065-effective-model-overrides.md)）。

每台电脑各改各的，同步时按份做三方合并，冲突时新的那份胜出、旧的那份留档；服务器上永远只有一份「整个 setup」的版本，而不是 profile 的镜像。

前三份切自 profile 的两个文件，`dirs` 与 `keys` 各是一份自己的东西。`dirs` 是让你把 profile 之外的目录（笔记、提示词、脚本）也带上：在「同步内容」里点附加目录那一行名称右边的**选择目录**（一个不带框的文字按钮），挑一个目录 —— 它连里面的文件一起封进同一个备份，在另一台电脑上恢复时**写回同一个路径**。它只增不减：同步会写会覆盖，但永远不会删掉里面的文件；这一行和其余四份一样有自己的开关（关掉只是「这台不带」，谁也删不掉），详见 [0036](docs/decisions/0036-extra-directories-part.md)。它的开关默认是**关**：目录整份带走，没点名要带之前不动它。

默认模型那一份（`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `agent-default-model` 行）**不在同步内容里**：换一次模型就换一次这一行，带着它只会让每次换模型都成为一次「本机有改动」的同步，而这一行本身没有多少值得跨机同步的东西。它留在各自的电脑上 —— 收集 patch 份时和本插件自己的 loader 行一样被排除（[0056](docs/decisions/0056-drop-default-model-part.md)）。

`keys` 补的是 profile 与「能用的配置」之间的那道缝：DSH 的 profile 里从来不存密钥，只存密钥的**名字**（`apiKeyEnv` / `secretEnv`），真值在本机的凭据服务里（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`）。只同步 profile 的话，另一台电脑会拿到一份完整的供应商列表，然后每个 provider 都报 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`。这一份把名字对应的值一起带走，同样用口令封在文件里；名字从即将发出的那几份配置里读出来，所以密钥跟着点它名的那一份走。只发**托管存储**里的值（环境导出的不发），**只写不删**，两边都改过时本机赢（凭据没有 mtime，比不出谁新）。详见 [0054](docs/decisions/0054-sync-api-keys.md)。

## 参考与来源

设计来自 [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie) 的 `internal/davsync`：同样是「一份密封文件 + 按份三方合并」的思路，本仓库把它移植到 TypeScript 并改成同步 DSH 的配置。

保留了的部分：

- **一份文件而不是镜像**：服务端只存整个 setup 的一个版本（`Bundle`），不是逐文件的目录镜像。
- **按份三方合并**：每个份单独哈希，改一份不会拖着别的份一起走。
- **新者胜 + 败者留档**：两边都改过时保留较新的，另一份写进本机 `sync/` 目录。
- **保守的写入**：读取记录的版本用于 `If-Match`，别的电脑在这中间写过就会被拒绝而不是被静默覆盖。

适配的部分：

- **Go → TypeScript**：一次同步按需进行 HTTP 往返与文件读写；可选的本机转发开启后另有一个随 Host 运行的回环监听器。
- **同步对象改成 DSH profile 行**：magpie 同步的是它自己的配置面；这里同步的是 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 loader 行和 profile 的 `package.json`，所以多了一层 YAML 文档级合并（保留注释、缩进与引号）。
- **`node_modules` 不参与同步**：只同步声明，包在同一台机器上用 pnpm 重新装（见「插件为什么不整目录同步」）。

## 安装

这是一个 DSH 插件，由 Host 半边（Node 侧）和浏览器半边（设置卡片）组成。装到 profile 里：

```bash
# 在 profile 目录里（$DSH_PROFILE_DIR，或 $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>）
pnpm add dsh-webdav-sync
```

然后在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加上本插件自己的 loader 行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webdav-sync
      name: 'dsh-webdav-sync'
```

`id` 是配置表单寻址用的 composition entry id（浏览器半边里的 `PLUGIN_ENTRY_ID` 与它一致），`name` 必须等于已安装的包名 —— 浏览器 bundle 按这个名字注册。上面这段就是包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 的全部内容（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向它），所以走 DSH 的 bundle 机制安装时会带上这一行；手动装则需要自己加。

包信息：`dsh-webdav-sync`，版本 `0.1.0`，MIT。

装好后重新加载界面，Settings 里会出现「WebDAV 同步」一页，Plugins 页上对应这张卡片也会出现。
