plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-web-panel

把 **DeepSeek 网页版**接进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：
主区域一个全局面板，用 Electron `<webview>` 加载真正的 `chat.deepseek.com`。
**不经过 API**，历史列表直接使用官网自带的侧栏，右键可删除对话。

> Bring the real DeepSeek website into DeepSeek Harness as a center panel. No API, no
> iframe: the page runs in an Electron `<webview>` guest approved by the desktop host.

## 使用

左侧栏底部有地球图标 **「网页区」**（侧栏收起时只显示图标）。点击后会**自动收起 DSH 左侧栏**，
让网页占满整个窗口；离开面板时自动恢复：

- 中间主区域切换成 DeepSeek 官网，**官网自己的侧栏就是历史列表**
  （今天 / 昨天 / 7 天内 / 30 天内 / 按月分组，置顶与多选都是官网原样）；
- **一键引用**：在网页里划选文字 → 点右侧中间悬浮的 **❝** 按钮 → 自动切回 DSH 对话并把选中内容
  以引用块（`> …`）插入输入框，原有草稿会保留（切回后再解析当前会话，所以面板被恢复时也能用）；
- **右键**侧栏里的任意对话 → 菜单「删除该对话」→ 再点一次确认 → 走官网自己的删除接口，
  删除成功后页面自动刷新。不可恢复，所以是两步确认；
- 侧栏收起时顶部留出 48px 窗口带，**整条带子**（DSH 控件右侧）都能按住拖动窗口；网页内容下移，避开红绿灯；
- 侧栏收起、面板贴到窗口左上角时，内容整体下移 48px，避开红绿灯和 DSH 的重新打开控件；
- 点左侧栏任意会话即可回到 DSH 对话。

## 环境要求

- **桌面版 DeepSeek Harness**（macOS / Windows / Linux）。网页版（`dsh web` 在浏览器里打开）
  没有 Electron webview，面板会显示「网页区需要在桌面版客户端中使用」。
- 复用桌面版已有的 webview 租约协议（`dshDesktop.browser`），没有绕开主进程的沙箱与网络策略。

## 安装

```bash
# 已发布到 npm 时（profile 用 desktop）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-deepseek-web-panel

# 从 tarball 安装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/dsh-deepseek-web-panel-0.3.0.tgz

# 本地开发（软链当前目录）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:$PWD
```

`dsh plugin add` 会自动把包写进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，**完全退出并重开客户端**后生效。
卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-deepseek-web-panel
```

## 实现

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`（浏览器半侧入口 `./client`） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 向 profile 插入 Loader 条目 `dsh-deepseek-web-panel` |
| `lib/index.js` | Node 半侧：空实现，只为让 Loader 有条目 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半侧：注册 `main` 面板（key `deepseek-web`）与 `sidebar.footer.action` 入口；面板内申请 webview 租约、加载站点，并往页面里注入右键删除 |

### 为什么是 webview

`chat.deepseek.com` 返回 `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'`，普通 iframe
一定被拒绝。桌面版主窗口开启了 `webviewTag`，主进程实现了一套 guest 租约：

1. `dshDesktop.browser.acquire(workspaceKey)` 申请租约，得到 `{ lease, partition }`；
2. 创建一个 `<webview name=lease partition=… src="about:blank#lease">` 并挂到 DOM；
3. 主进程在 `will-attach-webview` 校验租约/分区，随后收紧权限（sandbox、无 Node、
   拒绝权限请求、拦截下载、禁止访问 DSH 自身 host）；
4. `dom-ready` 之后 `loadURL()` 导航。

### 右键删除

站点的历史侧栏没有右键菜单，所以插件在网页自己的 origin 里注入一小段脚本：

- 先从站点自己的 `GET /api/v0/chat_session/fetch_page` 取一份「标题 → id」缓存；
- 监听左栏（`clientX ≤ 340`）的 `contextmenu`，用被点行的标题匹配会话；
- 菜单里的「删除该对话」第一次点击变为「再次点击确认删除」，确认后调用站点的
  `POST /api/v0/chat_session/delete`（`{ chat_session_ids: [id] }`）；
- 站点的 `userToken` 只在网页上下文内用于这次请求，插件不读取、不保存。

这是依赖站点内部 DOM/接口的增强，站点改版可能失效；失效时官网自带的「… → 删除」仍然可用。

### 一键引用

注入到网页里的 `selectionchange` 监听把当前选区记在 `window.__dshDeepSeekSelection`；点面板右侧的
❝ 按钮时，插件用 `executeJavaScript` 取回这段文字，切回会话界面，先等 `ctx.uiSession.current`
绑定出会话 id，再等 `ctx.conversation.input.shell()` 挂载，用 `actions.insertText()`（或 `setDraft()`）
插入引用块并聚焦输入框。找不到输入框时退回剪贴板。

打开面板时如果 DSH 左侧栏是展开的，插件会调用 `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()` 收起它；订阅
`ctx.layout.panelInfo`，离开面板时只在「是我们收起的、且现在仍收起」的情况下恢复。

### 窗口拖动

主区域叠 `-webkit-app-region: drag` 会吞掉下面网页的点击，所以拖动层不能常驻。
只在侧栏完全收起、面板贴住窗口左上角时，顶部会多出一条 48px 的空白带（网页内容下移让出来的），
这条带子从 DSH 的「重新打开侧栏 / 新会话」控件右侧一直延伸到窗口右边，整条都是拖动区；
侧栏展开时带子高度为 0，网页区域完全可点。

侧栏完全收起时（macOS 隐藏整列），面板获得 `--dsh-frame-leading-clearance`，此时给面板加
`padding-top: min(var(--dsh-frame-leading-clearance), 48px)`；拖动层用同样的高度，
`left: var(--dsh-frame-leading-clearance)`、`right: 0`，正好铺满这条带子。

## 自检

```bash
node test/smoke.mjs
```

模拟模块加载器、React、`slots`/`layout` 服务与 DOM，检查面板/入口注册、点击后
`layout.selectPanel("deepseek-web")`，以及右键删除脚本只安装一次、包含站点删除接口与二次确认。

## 发布

```bash
pnpm pack                 # 产出 dsh-deepseek-web-panel-<version>.tgz
pnpm publish --access public
```

发布前确认包名在 npm 上未被占用；如需改名，`package.json` 的 `name` 与
`cordis.patch.yml` 里 `name:` 必须一致（Loader 用包名解析）。

## License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness for VS Code: side-bar launcher, conversations beside the editor, native right-side slot. Unofficial community extension.
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek Harness for VS Code

> **Unofficial community extension** — not affiliated with DeepSeek.  
> The DeepSeek Harness runtime is MIT-licensed open source ([deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)).
>
> 非官方社区扩展，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。DeepSeek Harness 本体是 MIT 协议的开源项目。

**Landing page:** https://swording-k.github.io/dsh-vscode/

## Install  /  安装

**From GitHub (available now):** download `dsh-vscode-<version>.vsix` from
[Releases](https://github.com/swording-k/dsh-vscode/releases), then run
**Extensions: Install from VSIX…** from the Command Palette (`Cmd+Shift+P` on macOS).

**From the Marketplace:** search **DeepSeek Harness** in the Extensions view.

## What it does  /  它做什么

Put DeepSeek Harness in your editor: the **left launcher** shows your folder's
conversations; one click opens the full GUI **beside the editor** — ready to
read and write your source tree.

用 VS Code 管理 DeepSeek Harness 对话：左侧启动器列出当前文件夹的历史对话，一点就在编辑器右侧打开完整 GUI，直接读写你的项目文件。

## Entry points  /  入口（four places to reach it）

| Location | What |
|---|---|
| Left side bar (activity bar) | Whale icon → launcher with folder name, session list, and a new-chat button |
| Secondary side bar (right) | Same launcher, native right-side slot (VS Code ≥ 1.94) |
| Editor title (top-right) | Whale button → new conversation for the active folder |
| Status bar (bottom-right) | `DSH` → open the launcher |
| Command palette | `DSH: Open Panel`, `DSH: New Conversation`, `DSH: Refresh Conversations` |

## Prerequisites  /  先决条件

- Node.js ≥ 22
- DeepSeek Harness: `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`  
  The extension calls the `dsh` executable on PATH by default, or a
  checkout when `dshHarness.repoPath` is set.
- An API key: set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in your environment or use `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`.  
  The GUI's built-in Account settings let you enter the key on first launch.

## Usage  /  使用

1. Click the DeepSeek Harness icon in the left side bar (or use any entry point above).
2. The launcher shows your VS Code folder and its conversations; click **`+ New Conversation`**
   or pick a saved one. The full DSH GUI opens **on the right**, ready to read/write
   your workspace files.
3. The server starts automatically on first use; the theme follows your
   VS Code colour scheme (disable `dshHarness.syncTheme` if you prefer manual control).

## Settings  /  设置

| Setting | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `dshHarness.repoPath` | `""` | Optional path to a deepseek-harness source checkout (leave empty to rely on `dsh` from PATH) |
| `dshHarness.command` | `dsh` | Executable used when `repoPath` is empty (e.g. `dsh`, `pnpm dsh`) |
| `dshHarness.port` | `3080` | dsh web server port |
| `dshHarness.autoStart` | `true` | Start the server automatically when it is not running |
| `dshHarness.syncTheme` | `true` | Keep the DSH colour scheme in sync with your VS Code theme |

## Publishing  /  发布

The extension ships with a companion `dsh-plugin-deep-link` client plugin under
`plugin/`. On a stock `dsh` install it is auto-installed into the web profile
via `dsh plugin --profile web add …`. A source checkout already includes the
deep-link patch and does not need it.

Before publishing to the Marketplace:

1. Create a publisher: [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/manage) → create publisher.
2. Generate a Personal Access Token (Azure DevOps → Marketplace scope → **Manage**).
3. Log in: `npx @vscode/vsce login <publisher-id>`.
4. Replace `publisher` in `package.json` with your publisher id.
5. Replace the placeholder `repository.url` in `package.json` with your real GitHub repo URL.
6. Run `npm run package` (produces a `.vsix`) then `npx @vscode/vsce publish`.

## Known issues  /  已知限制

- Session targeting via `#session=<id>` relies on the `dsh-plugin-deep-link`
  plugin. Stock `@deepseek-ai/dsh` users get it auto-installed; source-checkout
  users on the `custom` branch already have it patched. Without either, the GUI
  opens normally and you select the conversation in the GUI sidebar — one extra click.
- The secondary side bar slot is not shown on VS Code builds older than 1.94.
- Multi-root workspaces are not yet supported (only the first folder is aligned).

## Development  /  开发

```bash
npm install
npm run compile        # tsc → out/
npm run package        # produces .vsix
```

Server logs appear in the **Output** panel under *DeepSeek Harness Server*.

plugins.description: Give Codex a DeepSeek crew: one MCP call hands a task to a fresh DSH agent that already has your skills, AGENTS.md and sign-in. V4.1-Flash at max reasoning, ~9k tokens per delegation, in the project directory you name.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subagent-mcp **Give Codex a DeepSeek crew.** One tool call hands a task to a fresh DeepSeek Harness agent that already has your skills, your `AGENTS.md` and your sign-in — and it works in the project directory you name, then hands back the answer. | What you get | Why it matters | |---|---| | **≈9k tokens per delegation** | A lite run costs about one file read, not a second conversation. | | **V4.1-Flash at reasoning `max`** | The strong preset is the default. Nothing to tune. | | **Your skills and `AGENTS.md`** | It behaves like the DSH you configured, because it uses your `DSH_HOME`. | | **Long tasks can't be killed by a timeout** | It waits `wait_sec`, then returns a task id you collect later. | | **Zero runtime dependencies** | ~600 lines with a hand-rolled JSON-RPC loop. Nothing to audit but the bridge. | | **One process, one turn** | No daemon, no state to leak between tasks, no edits to your DSH profile. | ```text Codex / Claude Code / any MCP client │ MCP over stdio ▼ dsh-subagent-mcp ← this package, zero deps │ spawn: dsh --profile

--patch --json ▼ DeepSeek Harness (headless) ← inherits DSH_HOME: AGENTS.md, skills, sign-in ▼ your project directory · one turn · final answer ``` ## Compared with other bridges in this space Bridges between agent hosts and DeepSeek Harness come in three shapes: a **resident daemon** that keeps agents alive and calls back into the host, an **SDK bridge** that runs workers in git worktrees, and a **relay** that exposes an already-running DSH instance. This package is the fourth: a **stateless one-shot bridge**. Where it wins, and where it deliberately loses: | Dimension | This package | Typical alternative | Why it matters | |---|---|---|---| | **Runtime dependencies** | **Zero** — only `dsh` itself | `ws` + `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` + `zod`, or a chain of SDK packages | A ~600-line single file is auditable in one sitting and cannot break because a transitive dep changed | | **Your DSH profile** | **Never touched** — config arrives as `--patch` overlays | Written into the profile, or requires a plugin on the DSH side | Upgrading DSH can't collide with a bridge that wrote itself into your config | | **Per-call cost** | **Two explicit tiers**: ≈9k or ≈300k tokens | One implicit size you discover on the bill | You choose the cost before the run | | **Lifetime** | One process per task, then exit | Resident daemon / worker pool | Nothing runs in the background; a crash can't poison the next task | | **Orphan processes** | Process-**tree** kill on cancel and shutdown | Sometimes leaves the MCP children `dsh` spawned | No slow memory drain after a few cancelled runs | | **Config inheritance** | Real `DSH_HOME` → your skills, `AGENTS.md`, sign-in | Some runtimes get an isolated temporary `DSH_HOME` (an empty shell) | The child actually behaves like the DSH you configured | | **Install** | `npx -y github:…`, no registry account | npm publish only | One config block, works today | | **Cold start** | ≈1.7 s per delegation ⚠️ | Warm daemon is faster | The honest price of statelessness | | **Native callback / session attach** | Not offered — needs host hooks ⚠️ | Daemon bridges call back natively and can attach to running sessions | If you need either, a daemon-shaped bridge is the right tool | Short version: pick this one when you want **a cheap, auditable, no-moving-parts way to hand work to DSH**; pick a daemon-shaped bridge when you want **long-lived agents that wake the host by themselves**. - **Default preset:** DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (id `deepseek-flash`) at reasoning effort `max`. - **Nothing to configure:** the first call creates its own `dsh-subagent` profile from the shipped headless template. ## Install Requires Node.js ≥ 22.19. The bundled dependency provides the `dsh` CLI. **A · straight from GitHub** — no clone, no build, no npm account: ```toml # ~/.codex/config.toml [mcp_servers.dsh_subagent] command = 'npx' args = ['-y', 'github:mbj733/dsh-subagent-mcp'] startup_timeout_sec = 60 ``` **B · pinned tarball** ```bash npm i -g https://github.com/mbj733/dsh-subagent-mcp/releases/download/v0.5.0/mbj733-dsh-subagent-mcp-0.5.0.tgz ``` **C · clone** (when you want to read or patch the code) ```bash git clone https://github.com/mbj733/dsh-subagent-mcp cd dsh-subagent-mcp && npm install ``` ```toml [mcp_servers.dsh_subagent] command = 'node' args = ['/absolute/path/to/dsh-subagent-mcp/index.mjs'] startup_timeout_sec = 30 ``` Restart the host afterwards. Then just ask: > Delegate to DSH: summarise `src/` and list the files that look unused. Work in `/path/to/project`. ## Tools | Tool | Overlay | What it does | |---|---|---| | `subagent_dsh` | lite | Delegate a task: skills, shell, file editing, web search — no MCP tools. ≈9k input tokens. | | `subagent_dsh_full` | full | Same, plus every MCP server declared in `overlay.yml`. ≈300k input tokens with a dozen servers. | | `subagent_dsh_status` | — | Collect a task. Accepts a task id (`t-…`) **or** a dsh session id. | | `subagent_dsh_continue` | — | Follow-up in the same dsh session; `cwd`/`overlay` default to the remembered values. | | `subagent_dsh_cancel` | — | Kill a running or queued task and its whole process tree. | | Argument | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `prompt` | — | Required. The child cannot see the host conversation — include everything it needs. | | `cwd` | — | Required. Absolute project directory. **Not a sandbox** (see Security). | | `wait_sec` | 120 | Wait before returning a task id. `0` returns immediately. | | `timeout_sec` | 1800 | Hard limit; on expiry the tree is killed and partial output returned. | | `read_only` | false | Ask the child to make no filesystem changes (instruction + detection, not a kernel sandbox). | | `format` | text | `json` returns `{ok, state, answer, usage, meta}`. | Long tasks are safe by design: the call waits `wait_sec`, then returns a task id, so a host-side tool timeout can never kill the work. ## Model and cost The child runs **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash** — model id `deepseek-flash` — at reasoning effort **max**. That is what both overlays ship; verify it yourself: ```bash dsh --profile dsh-subagent --patch overlay.lite.yml --dump-config | grep -A4 agent-default-model ``` The account line exposes two ids (checked against `GET https://api.deepseek.com/models`): | id | displayed as | |---|---| | `deepseek-flash` | DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · **default** | | `deepseek-v4-pro` | DeepSeek-V4-Pro | Switch per machine without editing files: `export DSH_SUBAGENT_MODEL=deepseek-v4-pro`. > Pin the **id**, not the label. Provider-specific ids from other lines — for example opencode's > `deepseek-v4.1-flash` — are not valid here; they need that provider's key and `base_url` on the > `dsh-subagent` profile. | Overlay | Mounts | Typical input tokens | Use it for | |---|---|---|---| | `lite` | credentials + skills | **~9,000** | writing, refactoring, analysis — anything done with shell and files | | `full` | + 11 MCP servers | **~300,000** | tasks that genuinely need PDF/office/browser/GitHub/map tools | A short `lite` reply, measured end to end: `startup 1.67s · work 1.19s · tokens in 9073 / out 2`. ## Verify an install without a host ```bash printf '%s\n' \ '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{}}}' \ '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}' \ | npx -y github:mbj733/dsh-subagent-mcp ``` Expect `serverInfo.name = dsh-subagent-mcp` and exactly five tools. **Installing this for someone else, or as an agent?** Read [`llms.txt`](llms.txt) for the machine-readable guide

plugins.description: Skill GoGo: a DSH panel plugin to browse, group, preview, export, install and rename skills, plus a multi-select skill menu in the composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# Skill GoGo

在 DSH 工作区里**浏览、分类、查看、选择、使用和下载 skill** 的面板插件。

装好之后，左侧边栏会出现一个「Skill GoGo」入口（书本图标），点开就是一个技能面板：

- **看**：列出当前 profile 能看到的全部 skill —— 用户目录（`$DSH_HOME/skills`）、项目级（`<工作区>/.dsh/skills`、`.agents/skills`）、内置（bundled）、自定义目录，带头部来源标签与数量统计。
- **分类**：自建文件夹把 skill 分组 —— 顶部「＋ 新建分类」新建；把 skill **拖到分类名上**即可归类；分类上**右键**可以重命名、改颜色、上移 / 下移排序、删除（删除后 skill 回到「未分类」）；skill 行右键也有「移动到分类」。折叠状态与分类库都会持久保存。
- **选**：搜索框（`/` 聚焦，匹配名称 / 描述 / 何时使用）、来源筛选 chip、行首复选框多选 + 批量「移动到分类」。
- **用**：
  - 面板里：详情页「使用」把 `/skill-name` 写进当前会话输入框（写不进去就退回复制到剪贴板）；「复制调用文本」只复制。
  - **对话输入区**：输入框左侧多了一个「**Skill**」菜单，点开是带搜索、按分类分组的 skill 列表，**可以多选**，点「插入调用」一次性把 `/a /b` 写进输入框（写不进去就整串复制到剪贴板）。
- **下载**：「下载」把 skill 目录打包成 `<name>-skill.zip`（含 `skill-gogo.manifest.json` 清单）；多选后可「批量下载」。
- **装进项目**：「复制到项目」把 skill 文件复制到 `<工作区>/.dsh/skills/<name>/`，之后该工作区的会话就能把它当项目级 skill 用（不覆盖已存在的同名目录）。
- **本地显示**：skill 行右键（或详情页按钮）「在本地显示文件」—— 用系统文件管理器打开该 skill 所在目录并**选中**入口文件（Windows 资源管理器 `/select`、macOS Finder `-R`、Linux `xdg-open`）；URL / opaque 型 skill 没有本地文件，该菜单项会置灰。
- **重命名**：skill 行右键「**重命名 skill**」—— 弹框改名后真正落盘：改写 `SKILL.md` 的 `name:` 字段；目录型 skill（目录名 = 旧名字）会顺手把**目录名**也改掉，平铺 `<name>.md` 会改文件名；分类归属自动跟着迁移；内置（`app.asar` 内只读）或没有本地文件的 skill 会拒绝并说明原因。
- **自定义目录**：顶部「目录」按钮可维护**多个**补充 skill 目录 —— 可浏览选择（带"含 SKILL.md"标记）、也可用系统目录选择器；这些目录里的 skill 会和用户目录一起出现在面板里，**并且注册进 `ctx.skills`（rank 250）**，所以模型和 `/名字` 调用同样能用。

面板文案跟随宿主语言（内置 zh / en 字典），配色只使用 DSH 主题 token，自动跟随明暗主题。

## 界面

![技能列表](docs/panel-list.png)

![技能详情](docs/panel-detail.png)

![分类界面](docs/panel-folders.png)

![右键重命名 skill](docs/rename-skill.png)

![对话输入区的 Skill 多选菜单](docs/composer-skill-menu.png)

![多选插入调用后](docs/composer-skill-inserted.png)

![本地显示文件](docs/reveal-menu.png)

---

## 目录结构

```text
skill-gogo/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch（宿主挂载）+ dsh.client（浏览器半区声明）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 挂载声明：- insert: [{ id: skill-gogo, name: dsh-skill-gogo }]
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # 宿主半区：/skill-gogo/api/* 接口 + 信任栅栏 + 提供方注册
│   ├── skills.mjs        # 数据层：skill 目录解析、文件枚举、zip 打包（无依赖）
│   ├── library.mjs       # 分类库：文件夹 / 归属 / 补充目录的读写与校验（原子写）
│   ├── customdirs.mjs    # 自定义目录：frontmatter 解析 + ctx.skills 提供方
│   └── zip.mjs           # 纯 JS 的 store 模式 zip 写入器（无第三方依赖）
├── lib/client.js         # 浏览器半区：官方 client 插件 bundle（无需构建）
├── test/
│   ├── smoke.mjs         # 数据层冒烟测试
│   └── host.test.mjs     # 宿主半区集成测试（真实 http 服务 + 38 项断言）
└── README.md
```

插件自己的数据只有一个文件：`$DSH_HOME/skill-gogo.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/skill-gogo.json`），
保存分类、归属与补充目录；写入前做完整校验（长度 / 数量 / 颜色白名单 / 绝对路径），
并采用"临时文件 + rename"原子落盘，坏数据一律回退为空库。

**没有构建步骤**：`lib/client.js` 按 `dsh-client-modules` 的懒加载工厂格式手工编写
（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`），只 `require('react')`，改完刷新页面即生效。

## 安装

桌面端（当前 profile）让 DSH 自己装 —— 会话里说一句，或用 `plugin_manager` 工具：

```
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "link:C:\\Users\\MaoYiJie\\Documents\\deepseek-harness\\default-workspace\\skill-gogo" }
```

`link:` 是软链安装：改本目录的代码即改插件（改了宿主半区要重启 DSH，只改前端刷新页面即可）。
若想拷一份进去、之后本目录可删，用 `target: "<绝对路径>"`（pnpm 会复制）。

命令行（`dsh` 在 PATH 上、且桌面端**完全退出**时可用）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:\Users\MaoYiJie\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\skill-gogo
```

卸载：`plugin_manager { action: "remove_bundle", target: "dsh-skill-gogo" }`。

> ⚠️ **桌面端首次安装后要重启一次桌面端**：Electron 外壳在启动时一次性收集 index 注入表
> （客户端插件的 boot 行就在这张表里），运行期新装的客户端 bundle 进不了已经启动的页面。
> 重启后侧边栏才会出现 Skill GoGo。

## HTTP 接口（宿主半区）

所有接口都在 `/skill-gogo/api/*`，只认回环地址 + 同源请求，写操作额外要求回环来源；
宿主存在 `connection.requestRejection` 时再委托它判一次，校验器自身出错一律按 403 处理。

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/skill-gogo/api/ping` | 存活与版本、已挂载路由表 |
| GET | `/skill-gogo/api/state?cwd=` | skill 目录 + 来源统计 + 工作区列表 + 分类库 + 目录状态 + 计数 |
| GET | `/skill-gogo/api/skill?name=&cwd=` | 单个 skill 的摘要 + 正文 + 文件清单 + 目录 |
| GET | `/skill-gogo/api/file?name=&cwd=&path=` | 预览 skill 目录内的单个文件（带越界保护） |
| GET | `/skill-gogo/api/export?name=&cwd=` | 打包下载 zip（`Content-Disposition: attachment`） |
| POST | `/skill-gogo/api/install` | `{name, cwd}` → 复制到 `<cwd>/.dsh/skills/<name>/` |
| GET | `/skill-gogo/api/library` | 读分类库（文件夹 / 归属 / 补充目录）+ 调色板 + 文件路径 |
| POST | `/skill-gogo/api/library` | 局部保存 `{folders?, assignments?, dirs?}`（改 `dirs` 会让提供方失效并重扫） |
| GET | `/skill-gogo/api/dirs` | 补充目录状态：是否存在、各含多少 skill |
| GET | `/skill-gogo/api/dirs/list?path=` | 目录浏览（给"添加目录"对话框用）：子目录 + 是否含 `SKILL.md` |
| POST | `/skill-gogo/api/rescan` | 手动让 skills 目录缓存失效并重扫 |
| POST | `/skill-gogo/api/reveal` | `{name, cwd}` → 在系统文件管理器里打开 skill 目录并选中入口文件；返回 `{revealed, mode, platform, dryRun}` |
| POST | `/skill-gogo/api/rename` | `{name, newName, cwd, renamePath?}` → 改 SKILL.md 的 `name`、可选改目录/文件名、迁移分类归属；非法名 400、重名 409、内置 skill 拒绝 |

> 设 `SKILLGOGO_REVEAL_DRY_RUN=1` 时 `/api/reveal` 只计算目标、不真正拉起文件管理器（自动化测试用）。

`cwd` 决定项目级 skill 是否可见；`ctx.skills` 按 scope 分层，插件会先用活跃 agent 作为
scope 查一次（拿到 preset 层的提供方），再补全局层，同名以更近的层为准。

## 验证状态

- `node test/host.test.mjs` —— **54 项断言全过**：目录 / 详情 / 文件预览 / 目录越界拒绝 /
  zip 导出（再用 Windows 自带 `Expand-Archive` 独立解压校验、内容逐字节一致）/
  复制到项目 / 重复复制拒绝 / 跨站与伪造 Host 与跨源 Origin 全部 403 /
  分类库保存与落盘回读 / 非法 dirs 拒绝 / 补充目录注册成提供方并进入目录 /
  目录浏览与 hasSkill 标记 / rescan 语义 / reveal 的 select 模式与 400/404/405 分支 /
  **rename：frontmatter 改写、目录型改目录名、平铺型改文件名、分类归属迁移、非法名 400、重名 409、未知 skill 500** /
  卸载后路由归零。（测试把 `DSH_HOME` 指到临时目录、`reveal` 走 dry-run，不会碰真实环境。）
- `node test/frontmatter.mjs` —— frontmatter `name` 改写的边界用例（LF / CRLF / 缺 name / 带引号 / 无 frontmatter）。
- 真实浏览器端到端（独立临时 profile + 临时 DSH_HOME + 系统 Edge）：
  - v0.2 分类/目录：**16 项全过** —— 面板打开、界面新建两个分类、右键菜单、右键重命名、
    右键改颜色（落盘颜色一致）、右键下移改变顺序、右键「移动到分类」、**真鼠标拖拽归类**、
    刷新后分类与归类仍在、打开目录对话框、浏览列出子目录并标记含 SKILL.md、补充目录保存、
    补充目录 skill 进入目录（source=custom）、来源 chip 出现「自定义目录」、无 JS 报错。
  - v0.3 本地显示：**6 项全过** —— 右键菜单含「在本地显示文件」、点击后返回
    `mode=select` 的 SKILL.md 真实路径、详情动作行同样有该按钮、无 JS 报错。
  - v0.4 重命名 + 输入区菜单：**16 项全过** —— 输入区「Skill」按钮出现、弹出多选面板、
    按分类列出 skill、多选计数、插入（写输入框或复制兜底）、弹层关闭、右键菜单含
    「重命名 skill」、对话框预填原名、非法名前端拦截、重命名成功并刷新列表、
    磁盘上 frontmatter 与目录名都已更新、无 JS 报错。
- 安装包校验（从 tgz 装进全新 profile）：**5 项全过** —— 客户端 boot 图含 bundle、
  宿主版本与路由表、右键菜单项存在、点击返回真实本地路径、无 JS 报错。
- **桌面端（desktop profile）**：宿主半区是 `link:` 装的工作区目录；v0.4 的宿主部分
  （`/api/rename`、`/api/reveal`、分类接口）需要**重启一次 DSH** 才会加载，前端 bundle 刷新页面即更新。

## 已知限制

- 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`：该服务缺失时面板显示「skill 服务不可用」而不是空白。
- 「使用」与输入区「插入调用」优先调用 DSH 输入区插槽的正式 API
  （`inputActions.captureInsertion()` → `insertText(text, token)`，与宿主自己的插入通道一致）；
  拿不到该句柄时才退回操作 `[data-composer-input]`，再不行则**自动把调用串复制到剪贴板**并提示。
- 只处理本地目录型 skill（`resourceBase.kind === 'directory'`）；URL / opaque 型 skill 只展示元信息，不提供下载、本地显示与重命名。
- 「在本地显示文件」是宿主进程直接拉起系统文件管理器（`explorer.exe /select` / `open -R` / `xdg-open`），
  只在插件自己的 HTTP 接口里触发，接口仍受回环 + 同源信任栅栏保护。
- 「重命名 skill」会**真的改磁盘文件**：改写 `SKILL.md` 的 `name:`；当目录名等于旧名字时连目录一起改名，
  平铺 `<name>.md` 改文件名。内置 skill 在 `app.asar` 内只读，会被拒绝。
- 导出走 store 模式 zip（不压缩），大目录受 `lib/skills.mjs` 的 `DEFAULT_LIMITS` 限制（400 个文件 / 单文件 2 MB / 合计 32 MB）。

plugins.readme_text:
# 天机阁 · Algorithm Codex

> [English](README.md) · [中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

The plugin is the *interface*; the codex itself lives in the `algo-hub` repository one level up
(`data/algorithms.json` + `data/taxonomy.json`). A standalone install carries a seed snapshot (`seed/`)
and seeds `~/.dsh/tianjige` on first run, so the same package works without the repository.

## Features

- **Search** — `tianji_search` finds algorithms by natural language or keywords, with filters for
  domain, function key, maturity and “has a ready implementation”. Strict match first, partial
  match as a fallback, clickable repo/package links in the result.
- **Dossier** — `tianji_get` returns one full entry: how it works, tradeoffs, complexity, papers,
  implementations, sibling variants of the same function, caveats.
- **Ask** — `tianji_ask` lets the model answer a design question from the codex first, and opt in
  to a web search for algorithms outside it (`findNew: true`).
- **Sweep** — `tianji_sweep` searches the web for new algorithms, turns them into candidate drafts
  under `data/pending/`, and can run on a daily schedule (`action=status|start|config`).
- **Curation** — `tianji_stage` / `tianji_update` / `tianji_review` / `tianji_review_mark` /
  `tianji_stats` / `tianji_usage` cover adding, editing, reviewing, auditing and token accounting.
- **UI** — a left-sidebar row opens a full-page view with four tabs (Codex / Arena / Sweep / Ask),
  and the same page is also available as a right-sidebar tab.

## Install

The package is the `tianjige-plugin/` directory. Install it into a DSH profile and enable it:

```powershell
# from the GitHub release (no npm account needed)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/MengXingXiaoMing/dsh-tianjige/releases/download/v1.3.0/dsh-tianjige-1.3.0.tgz

# from npm, once the package is published
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tianjige

# from a local checkout (development): add the directory itself
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:\path\to\algo-hub\tianjige-plugin
```

Use your own profile name instead of `desktop` if you run a different one. Restart DSH afterwards:
the host half is imported once at startup and a page refresh does not reload it. Before restarting you
can smoke-check the sources with `node --check host.js` and `node --check lib/*.mjs`.
## Configuration

The plugin inserts one row (`id: tianjige`) through `cordis.patch.yml`. Both keys are optional:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dataDir` | parent directory of this package (= repository root) | codex root containing `data/` and `server/ai.mjs` |
| `defaultLimit` | `8` | default number of rows returned by `tianji_search` |

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: tianjige
      name: dsh-tianjige
      config:
        dataDir: D:\wherever\algo-hub   # optional, derived by default
        defaultLimit: 8
```

## Data layout

```
algo-hub/
  data/
    algorithms.json   # merged codex (219 entries)
    taxonomy.json     # the 13 domains
    review.json       # review ledger
    coverage.json     # sweep coverage matrix (written once a sweep ran)
    staging/          # per-agent material waiting for merge
    pending/          # AI drafts waiting for human review
    runs/             # one ledger per sweep run
    logs/             # page error reports (client-YYYY-MM-DD.log)
  server/ai.mjs       # AI logic for the old web edition (the plugin uses lib/ai.mjs)
  tools/algohub.py    # CLI: validate / merge / export / stats / coverage / record-run / snapshot …
```

When the plugin is installed from npm there is no repository around it, so the first run copies the bundled starter library (`seed/algorithms.json`, `seed/taxonomy.json`) into `~/.dsh/tianjige` and keeps every write there. Set `dataDir` (or `DSH_TIANJIGE_DATA_DIR`) to override; a link / development install keeps using the repository root.

## Compatibility

- **DSH** `>=0.2.1-rc.2` (`dsh.engines.dsh`), **Node** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- No `@deepseek-ai/*` dependency at all: the host entry has zero imports, and both the data layer
  and the AI layer are loaded by dynamic import, so a copy inside a profile can never shadow the
  runtime version.
- AI tools (ask / sweep / AI-assisted review) need `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`: an environment variable, or
  a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY:` line in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`. Without a key the other tools keep
  working and the AI tools return `AI_NO_KEY`.
- The only peer dependency is `react` (client half, provided by the harness).

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `tianji_search` | Search entries (`query`, optional `domain` / `functionKey` / `maturity` / `hasImpl` / `limit`) |
| `tianji_get` | Full dossier by `id` |
| `tianji_ask` | Natural-language design question (`task`, optional `findNew` web search) |
| `tianji_sweep` | Sweep: `action=status` / `start` / `config` (daily auto-sweep switch and interval) |
| `tianji_stage` | Stage a new candidate (writes `data/staging/`, waits for human merge) |
| `tianji_update` | Edit an existing entry in place (automatic backup) |
| `tianji_review` / `tianji_review_mark` | Review queue: list items / record a verdict |
| `tianji_stats` | Codex audit: entry count, domain spread, implementation coverage, review progress |
| `tianji_usage` | AI token ledger (read / delete / clear / retention) |

## UI surfaces

The plugin registers three seats:

- `sidebar.panellist` — one row “天机阁” in the left sidebar (`order: 120`)
- `main` — a full-page view opened from that row (tabs: Codex / Arena / Sweep / Ask)
- `sidebar.right.pane.tab` — the same page as a right-sidebar tab

Page data goes through host routes `/api/tianjige/{library,meta,sweep,ask,review,usage,write,log}`,
which accept loopback requests only. Without a `webServer` service the plugin degrades to
“tools only, no page”.

## Troubleshooting

- **Nothing shows up after install** — restart DSH first; then check the `application` field
  returned by `plugin_manager`.
- **Page says “sweep status unavailable”** — usually a dependency module failed to load (for
  example a missing `lib/ai.mjs`); the route writes the error into the `/api/tianjige/meta` 500
  response. Check with `node --check lib/sweep.mjs`.
- **`AI_NO_KEY` from `tianji_ask`** — configure the key as described under Compatibility.
- **Data validation** — `python tools/algohub.py validate` (expect 0 errors, 0 warnings) and
  `doctor` for reference checks.

## Development

- Host: `host.js` (entry, tools + routes), `lib/sweep.mjs` (sweep / review / ask),
  `lib/ai.mjs` (AI calls and prompts), `lib/usage.mjs` (token ledger), `lib/entries.mjs`
  (entry read/write helpers).
- Client: `lib/client.js` (React, single-file bundle registered into a slot).
- Tests: `npm test` runs `node --test test/smoke.test.mjs` — offline, zero dependencies, against
  `test/fixtures/`; it never touches real data and does not need the plugin to be installed.
- Static checks: `dsh-plugin-dev check --strict` (from the `dsh-plugin-guide` skill package) and
  `node --check` on every entry.

## Publishing

There are two distribution channels; both are optional and GitHub stays the source of truth.

**Cut a release (maintainers).** Bump `version`, run `npm test` and `dsh-plugin-dev check --strict`,
then pack the tarball and attach it to a GitHub release:

```powershell
npm pack
gh release create v<version> dsh-tianjige-<version>.tgz --title "v<version>" --notes "..."
```

**npm (optional).** After `npm login`, run `npm publish --access public`. Users then install with
`dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tianjige`. Publishing to npm is not required for the marketplace.

**DSH marketplace.** Registration lives in [`awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin):
one file per plugin at `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml`, holding `url`, `name`, `category`, an optional
`tarball`, and `description.en` (plus `description.zh` if you can). The requirements are a public repo,
`dsh.bundle.patch` in `pac

plugins.description: Agent-initiated restart for DeepSeek Harness: journal, WMI relaunch, automatic continuation after restart. Windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-restart

[English](./README.md) | [中文](./README.zh.md)

Lets DeepSeek Harness (DSH NEXT desktop) pick up unfinished work by itself after the agent restarts the app.

## What problem it solves

Restarting kills the current turn, and a new turn only starts when something triggers it. The usual choices are waiting for the human to speak again or losing context and starting over. This plugin makes restart part of the workflow:

- Record the pending work before restarting; open a fresh turn automatically afterwards, so the user never has to restate it.
- Only agent-initiated restarts trigger this. Closing and reopening the app by hand does nothing.
- The restart tool confirms the helper actually started; if it did not, it reports failure instead of a silent success.

## Compatibility

- Built for DSH NEXT desktop `2.0.17-next` (bundled `@deepseek-ai/*` at `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Windows only: restart relies on PowerShell and WMI.
- The continuation message is queued through host services (`sessionController`, `sessions`). Those are internal interfaces and may change between DSH releases, so re-verify after upgrading. The plugin does not promise compatibility with older DSH versions; when it cannot work it reports an error instead of failing silently.

## Features

### 1. The `restart_harness` tool

- Writes a restart journal (reason, pending work, voice state, session id) and generates an external helper script.
- Creates the helper through WMI so it leaves the app's process tree: wait, kill the app, wait for exit, write a one-shot marker, then relaunch.
- After launching, checks `restart.log` to confirm the helper actually started; otherwise reports failure.

### 2. Automatic continuation after restart

- Five seconds after the app is ready (plugin apply), queues a message with source `restart` into the session and opens a new turn.
- Queued once. No goal, no completion mark, no system-prompt injection. Retries every 3 seconds, up to 6 times.
- The UI renders it as a system notice (“execution requested”), not as a user message.

### 3. Handover to the voice plugin

- Records whether voice mode was on before restart and writes `voice-resume.json` on startup.
- The voice plugin (`dsh-voice-mode-desktop`) reads that file and decides whether to restore voice mode. The two plugins install independently and do not depend on each other.

## Execution flow

1. The agent calls `restart_harness(reason, pending)`; the plugin writes `restart-journal.json`.
2. The plugin generates the helper script and creates the helper process through WMI, outside the app's process tree.
3. The helper waits, kills `DSH NEXT`, waits for exit, writes the one-shot marker `agent-restart.flag`, and relaunches the app.
4. On startup the plugin reads the journal only when the marker exists (manual launches have no marker); it writes `voice-resume.json` for the voice plugin and removes the marker.
5. Five seconds after the app is ready, the plugin queues the source-`restart` continuation message and opens a new turn.
6. The agent finishes the pending work and reports; the journal becomes `continued`.

## Integration with the voice plugin

Before restarting, the plugin records the voice state (on/off, active session id) in the journal. After restart it writes `voice-resume.json`; the voice plugin reads it on startup and restores voice mode when needed, then acknowledges and deletes the file.

So voice state survives the restart: if it was on before, it is on afterwards and you can hold to speak. Only agent-initiated restarts use this path; manual launches do not auto-restore. If the voice plugin is not installed, restart still works without voice restoration.

## Why not in-app relaunch or a community restart plugin

Restarting in-process via Electron's relaunch looks cleanest, but it is unreachable here: the plugin runs in a host subprocess without the Electron `app` object. The renderer does expose a restart command, but it shows a native confirmation dialog and must be relayed through the UI. Removing the dialog would mean patching DSH's main process — platform core, overwritten by upgrades, not worth it.

Community restart plugins were evaluated too: they ship their own watchdog process plus a token-protected HTTP route, wrapping the external-process approach in more moving parts and requiring per-version adaptation. The cost outweighs the benefit.

That leaves an external helper process created through WMI: the only restart path verified to work on this machine, and it leaves DSH core untouched so the plugin can be updated independently.

## Known limitations

- Restart needs a path outside the app's process tree. The launcher is invoked synchronously and its exit code is checked: if it exits non-zero or the helper never writes its first log line, the tool reports the exact failure instead of claiming success.
- Windows only.
- Voice restoration only happens when the voice plugin is installed.

## Install

Requirements: Windows, DSH NEXT desktop `2.0.17-next`, PowerShell and WMI available.

Option A (recommended):

1. Install the npm package: `npm install @nutshelllee/dsh-agent-restart` (or add it to the DSH profile dependencies).
2. Add `- id: agent-restart, name: "@nutshelllee/dsh-agent-restart"` to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` insert list.
3. Restart DSH; `restart_harness` appears in the tool list.

Option B (local development): link this repository into `node_modules/@nutshelllee/dsh-agent-restart` of the profile, then follow steps 2 and 3.

## License

MIT, see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zai-usage

Z.AI coding-plan quota panel in the DSH sidebar.

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin,
packaged as a DSH bundle: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `zai-usage` row into the active profile.
The client half is served from `lib/client.js` (`dsh.client.platform: web`).

## Install

- Desktop app: **Plugins** → install `github:bosenok/dsh-zai-usage` (private repository:
  give the machine git access), then enable the bundle.
- CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:bosenok/dsh-zai-usage`.
- Local checkout: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:/path/to/dsh-zai-usage`.

Enabling the bundle mounts the plugin; HMR applies it to a running app, and a
restart makes sure the client half is rebuilt.

> Note for the app-managed `desktop` profile: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add`
> only installs the dependency and copies the package; unlike a regular profile
> it does not enable the bundle. Enable it by adding the package name to
> `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (or through the
> Plugins page). Other profiles enable the installed bundle automatically.


## Where the key comes from

The host half declares `inject: ['credentials']` and resolves the key through the
harness credential service — the same canonical seam the Z.AI provider itself
uses:

```js
const resolved = await ctx.credentials.resolve('ZAI_API_KEY')
```

So there is nothing plugin-specific to configure. The value is found in the
service's layers: the credential store written when the Z.AI provider is
configured (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` → `refs`), or the environment layers
(`~/.dsh/.env`, inherited environment, the project's `.env`). The value never
reaches the browser: the client half renders the quota snapshot only.

Missing key: the panel shows `ZAI_API_KEY is not set in the credential store`, and
the snapshot `~/.dsh/usage/zai-usage.json` carries `debug` with the resolution
state (`credsService`, `resolve`) — for instance
`{"credsService":"ok","resolve":"value(49) source=file"}`.

## Development

`lib/` is built and committed; the sources live in `src/`. Rebuild the client with
the repository's Vite config (`npx vite build` → `dist/`, then the wrapper in
`build/wrapper.js` produces `lib/client.js`).

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Third-party code bundled into `lib/` and its
licenses are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

plugins.description: Layered long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis): project/global/habit stores, progressive disclosure, zero-LLM core, two-gate habit learning.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-memory

Cross-project **long-term memory** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH 0.2.x),
built as a Cordis plugin bundle.

Three abilities, one plugin:

1. **Cross-project long-term memory** — four physically separated stores (session / project / global /
   habit), project memory travels with the repository, global preferences follow `DSH_HOME`.
2. **Token-efficient recall** — progressive disclosure: a hard-capped resident index plus on-demand
   `memory_recall` / `memory_expand`, with byte-stable injected prefixes for prompt-cache friendliness.
3. **User-habit adaptation** — a deterministic, auditable pipeline (`observe → threshold → judge (optional)
   → candidate → human gate 1 → suggested → human gate 2 → auto`). A model can never promote a habit.

**Zero LLM calls is a first-class mode.** Write, recall, inject, forget, consolidate, health reporting and
the whole habit pipeline work with no model route configured. The optional judge model defaults to **off**
and fails open when configured but broken.

---

## Ecosystem references and deliberate deviations

This design was built against the real DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 runtime (inspected services, events, tool contracts
and client slots), taking the following four plugins as design starting points. Where their assumptions
conflict with the current runtime, the runtime wins; deviations are listed explicitly.

| Reference | Aligned with | Deviation and why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh-plugin-memory` | Layered stores, index/topic separation, hard truncation budgets, keyword-only retrieval when no LLM route exists | Stores are kept in four roots that are validated as strictly non-nested (the runtime refuses to start memory if project/global/habit roots alias). Retrieval also has a per-session cumulative budget and an explicit, observable degradation ladder, not only per-call truncation. |
| `dsh-sieve` | Judge model as an optional token-pruning decision maker, fail-open semantics, spill archive of originals, disclosure trade-off | Our judge only decides *habit-pattern yes/no* from ≤5 evidence slices; it never prunes conversation context on the main path. Memory bodies are disk-first and recall/expand are capped; spill primitives exist for originals, but automatic conversation-level offload is a host concern (see "Long-task offload (status in 0.1.0)"). |
| `dsh-habit` | Deterministic correction detection, threshold trigger, candidate zone, two human gates, "model cannot self-promote" | Habit entries live in their own store with their own tombstone file, and the promotion path exists **only** on the host HTTP UI route. There is no tool parameter that can confirm or promote a habit — this is stricter than an `actor` check at the tool boundary. |
| `dsh-progressive-tools` | Byte-stable prefix as a constraint on progressive disclosure, accepting a smaller first request | We keep the injected section text byte-identical while its content signature is unchanged, and disclose nothing new per turn: the index only changes when memory content changes (new write / forget / consolidation / health transition). We do not shrink the visible tool table dynamically — see "Cache stability" below for the measurement rationale. |

**Deviation from the reference plugins' packaging:** this repo ships `lib/` (build output) inside the
package and commits it, so a fresh clone of the repository produces a bundle that can be installed
without a build step in the target profile. `defineTool` is satisfied by a local, dependency-free
implementation of the documented contract (`src/tool.ts`) rather than importing
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` from the plugin directory: a bundle installed at `$DSH_HOME/plugins/<name>`
cannot resolve Harness-internal packages from `node_modules` that is not an ancestor of the plugin
directory (Cordis loads the plugin as a process-internal ESM import; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is not on
that resolution path). The emitted tool definitions match the documented wire contract
(`name`, `description`, `parameters` as JSON Schema, `output.schema`, `execute(args, exec)`), and `execute`
respects `exec.signal`. If your harness resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` from the bundle location, replace
`src/tool.ts`'s `defineTool` import with the package export — the rest of the code is unchanged.

---

## Runtime assumptions (Cordis v4)

These are the assumptions the implementation is written against; every one of them was checked against the
installed 0.2.0-rc.1 packages rather than inferred from prose.

1. **Plugin shape.** A bundle is an ESM package whose `dsh.bundle.patch` points at a Cordis patch. The
   patch has one `- insert:` row (`id`, `name`, `config`). The Loader imports the package in-process and
   calls `apply(ctx, config)`. Host module exports `name`, `inject`, `apply`.
2. **Lifecycle.** Everything that owns an OS resource (timers, watchers, subscriptions, HTTP routes) is
   registered inside `ctx.effect(() => disposer, 'label')`, so Cordis calls the disposer on unload in
   reverse order. No `process.on`, no unref'd timers, no writes to `document`/`body`.
3. **Dual-sided plugin.** The Host half (`src/`, built to `lib/`) owns storage, retrieval, injection, tools
   and the HTTP review surface. The Client half (`client/index.js`, built to `lib/client/index.js`) is a
   `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) })` bundle that registers a settings page into the
   `settings.section` slot via `ctx.slots.register({ name: 'settings.section', id, order, label }, Component)`.
4. **Dependency declaration.** Required services go in `inject` (`['tools']`). Optional services are
   acquired with `ctx.inject(['systemPrompt' | 'llm' | 'webServer'], …)` inside a scoped callback, so a
   profile without them simply doesn't get those features. A missing optional service is never an
   activation error: the plugin starts, the core works, and the health file/UI says which feature is off.
5. **Tool contract.** `ctx.tools.register(defineTool({ name, description, parameters, output: { schema,
   render }, execute }))`. `parameters` is the author-facing property map (converted to JSON Schema);
   `execute` returns exactly the canonical value declared by `output.schema`; UI rendering is a pure
   projection (`render(args, value) -> ContentBlock[]`), not business logic.
6. **Injection.** Memory index text is added with `ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'dsh-memory', order: 40,
   text: () => runtime.refresh().text, interpolate: false })` inside `ctx.inject(['systemPrompt'], …)`, and
   removed by the disposer on unload. The section is a function so the assembly can read the cached,
   byte-stable block; it never mutates the prompt per turn.
7. **Session source of truth.** The plugin does not append session events with new types. Habit observation
   subscribes to the existing post-commit `session/event` emit and reads only `user/message` content;
   derived data lives in the plugin's own stores.

---

## Architecture

```
             ┌──────────────────────────── plugin (in-process ESM) ───────────────────────────┐
 DSH Loader ─┤ apply(ctx, config)                                                            │
             │   ├─ tools: memory_remember / recall / expand / forget / consolidate / status   │
             │   │         / feedback / habits                                                 │
             │   ├─ systemPrompt.section("dsh-memory")  ← byte-stable index (hard capped)       │
             │   ├─ session/event subscription          ← deterministic correction detection   │
             │   ├─ optional webServer routes            ← /dsh-memory/status, /dsh-memory/habits│
             │   └─ optional llm route                   ← habit judge only (default off)       │
             └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### The four stores (physical isolation is a hard constraint)

| Layer | Path (default) | Follows | Shared via git | Written by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| session | in-memory `SessionBudget` only | the session | no | recall accounting |
| project | `<repo>/.dsh/memory/` | repository (`.git`/`.d

plugins.description: DSH Web 插件：模型供应商额度与用量（DeepSeek / GLM Coding Plan / OpenRouter / Kimi Coding + 自定义适配器）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-usage

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@ponydev/dsh-model-usage)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ponydev/dsh-model-usage)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@ponydev/dsh-model-usage)](LICENSE)

**DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web UI 插件：实时显示模型供应商的额度与用量。**

- 侧边栏底部：当前供应商的额度/余额卡片，点击打开全部供应商弹窗（Codex 式）
- 官方 Logo：DeepSeek / GLM(Z.ai) / Kimi / OpenRouter / MiniMax / OpenCode / OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / xAI / Qwen / Mistral / Groq / GitHub Copilot 等 25+
- 设置 → 模型用量：KPI、趋势图、供应商/模型聚合、请求日志、CSV 导出
- 设置 → 模型：页面底部显示各供应商额度
- 版本检查：设置 → 模型用量 右上角「检查更新」（对比 npm 最新版，可复制更新命令）
- 只用**真实数据**：额度来自服务商接口，用量来自本机会话日志（逐 token 一致），不做金额估算

![侧边栏额度卡片](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PonyDevAI/dsh-model-usage/main/docs/screenshots/01-sidebar.png)

![模型用量弹窗](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PonyDevAI/dsh-model-usage/main/docs/screenshots/02-modal.png)

![统计面板](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PonyDevAI/dsh-model-usage/main/docs/screenshots/03-settings.png)

![请求日志](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PonyDevAI/dsh-model-usage/main/docs/screenshots/04-request-log.png)

## 安装

要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0`。

```bash
# CLI
dsh plugin --profile web add @ponydev/dsh-model-usage

# 或在 Web「插件」页搜索安装
```

安装后重启宿主（`launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/local.deepseek-harness.web`）并刷新页面。

本地开发：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-model-usage
```

## 供应商支持（完整矩阵见 [docs/providers.md](docs/providers.md)）

| 供应商 | 数据接口 | 凭据引用 |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek API | `api.deepseek.com/user/balance` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |
| DeepSeek 账号 | Host `deepseekAccount` 服务（登录态） | — |
| GLM Coding Plan（国内 / 国际） | `open.bigmodel.cn` / `api.z.ai` 额度接口（5 小时 / 每周 / **每月 MCP 工具次数**） | `ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY` / `ZAI_API_KEY` |
| OpenRouter | `openrouter.ai/api/v1/credits`（兜底 `/api/v1/key`） | `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` |
| Kimi Coding Plan | `api.kimi.com/coding/v1/usages` | `KIMI_CODING_API_KEY` / `KIMI_API_KEY` / `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` |
| Moonshot / Kimi 平台 | `api.moonshot.{ai,cn}/v1/users/me/balance` | `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` / `MOONSHOT_CN_API_KEY` |
| MiniMax Token Plan | `api.minimax.io` / `api.minimaxi.com` `/v1/token_plan/remains` | `MINIMAX_API_KEY` / `MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY` |
| OpenCode Go | `opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` | `OPENCODE_API_KEY` |
| Xiaomi MiMo | `platform.xiaomimimo.com/api/v1/balance` | `XIAOMI_API_KEY` |
| GitHub Copilot | `api.github.com/copilot_internal/user` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` |
| 其他任意供应商 | `customQuota` 配置（URL + JSON 路径映射） | 自定义 `keyRef` |

`customQuota` 示例（余额式）：

```yaml
config:
  customQuota:
    mycoder:
      url: https://api.example.com/quota
      auth: bearer                 # bearer | raw | x-api-key | none
      keyRef: MYCODER_API_KEY
      balance:
        path: data.balance
        currency: CNY
```

窗口式：

```yaml
config:
  customQuota:
    mycoder:
      url: https://api.example.com/quota
      windows:
        - key: rolling
          label: 5h
          usedPath: data.used
          limitPath: data.limit
          resetAtPath: data.resetAt   # ms | s | iso
          resetAtUnit: ms
```

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 中 `model-usage` 行的 `config`：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `refreshSeconds` | 60 | 额度刷新间隔（秒） |
| `footer` | true | 是否显示侧边栏底部入口 |
| `credentials` | `{}` | 按路由覆盖凭据引用，如 `{ "deepseek-official": "MY_DEEPSEEK_KEY" }` |
| `glm` | `{}` | GLM 组织/项目/套餐类型：`organization` / `project` / `planType` |
| `customQuota` | `{}` | 通用额度适配器（见上） |

## 数据口径

- **用量**：`assistant/message` 事件中的服务商回传 usage（input / cacheRead / cacheWrite / output），与本机会话日志逐 token 一致
- **额度/余额**：服务商接口返回的真实值（DeepSeek 余额、GLM 5h/周剩余、Kimi 周/滚动窗口、OpenRouter credits）
- **真实消耗观测**：每次刷新比对余额/套餐额度变动，得到当日实际支出（余额下降）与充值（余额上升，分开记录不冲抵）
- **不做金额估算**：订阅套餐按套餐额度计费而不是按 API 逐次扣费，任何估算都会误导
- **统计范围**：本机、安装后写入会话日志的调用；旁路调用（标题生成/压缩摘要）与其他设备不计
- 账本文件：`$DSH_HOME/model-usage/ledger.json`（按日聚合，保留 120 天；首次启动回填近 30 天）

## 安全

- API Key 只在 Host 内存中解析使用，**不进入浏览器**，任何 RPC 响应都不包含密钥
- 只请求写死的白名单接口域名；客户端不能指定 URL
- 账本只存用量聚合（token 数、窗口百分比），不含对话内容
- 错误信息脱敏（`sk-*` / `Bearer *` 会被打码）

## 开发与发布

- 开发环境、联调方式、提交前检查：[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- 项目级规范（AI/自动化代理必读）：[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
- **发布流程（tag 触发自动发布，OIDC 无 token）**：[RELEASE.md](RELEASE.md)
- 架构设计：[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)

```bash
# 本地渲染台（离线验证 UI，不依赖宿主）
open test-render.html

# 发版（自动发布到 npm + GitHub Release）
npm version patch && git push --follow-tags
```

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH plugin: decision notes (Agent Notes) — 把「为什么这样改、放弃了什么」沉淀成可机械校验的仓库笔记：技能、会话开关、真门禁、上游合并
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-notes

[English](README.en.md) | **中文**

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)

把「为什么这样改、放弃了什么」变成仓库里**可机械校验**的决策笔记，装进 DeepSeek Harness。

> 方法提炼自 [czm15053/write-notes-like-deepseek](https://github.com/czm15053/write-notes-like-deepseek)（它又提炼自 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 `.agents/notes/` 实践）。
> 本插件把那套方法做成 DSH 原生插件：技能、会话开关、真门禁、上游合并。

## 它解决什么

代码能表达「系统现在怎么跑」，表达不了「**为什么必须这样跑、以及放弃了什么**」。于是每个新会话都会：
自作聪明地「优化」掉一段当年为避免死锁而刻意写别扭的代码；为赶局部需求打穿全局结构；把三个月前已证明会内存溢出的方案再提一遍。

本插件让规矩**绕不开**：和代码同仓库、同一次改动、机械校验、旧决定封存带封印。

## 安装

```sh
# 从本地目录装进你的 profile（开发期）
dsh plugin add --profile <你的profile> /path/to/dsh-agent-notes

# 或从 GitHub
dsh plugin add --profile <你的profile> github:iuuuuuuuu/dsh-agent-notes
```

> **注意：`plugin add` 只写依赖，不会把插件加进启用列表。** 实测确认：它把
> 包名写进 `profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dependencies`，但
> `dsh.profile.bundles` 里没有这一项 —— 而 DSH 是按 `bundles` **逐层加载**
> 插件的（每层读该包自己的 `cordis.patch.yml`）。所以只 `add` 的话插件装了
> 却不生效，`--dump-config` 里也看不到它。
>
> 还需要手动把包名加进 `bundles`：
>
> ```jsonc
> // $DSH_HOME/profiles/<你的profile>/package.json
> "dsh": {
>   "profile": {
>     "bundles": [
>       "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
>       "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
>       "dsh-agent-notes"        // ← 加这一行
>     ]
>   }
> }
> ```
>
> 然后**重启 DSH**。验证是否真加载：`dsh --profile <你的profile> --dump-config`
> 里应出现 `# == dsh-agent-notes` 与 `- id: agent-notes`。若只在依赖里而不在
> `bundles` 里，启动日志不会有报错，插件却完全没跑 —— 这是最容易踩空的一步。

## 用起来

```
/agent-notes                 查看开关与笔记树状态
/agent-notes on              开启本会话的决策笔记（持久化，重载后保持）
/agent-notes on --global     改全局默认（影响所有未单独覆盖的会话）
/agent-notes reset           清除本会话覆盖，回到全局默认
/agent-notes init            在当前仓库建出 .agents/notes 骨架
/agent-notes gate            跑真门禁（也可 gate tree / gate format / gate archived）
```

### 默认是关闭的

装好插件后，**新会话和旧会话默认都不启用**，需要时手动打开（点胶囊，或
`/agent-notes on`）。这样装上插件不会悄悄改变任何既有会话的行为。

想让所有会话默认开启，二选一：

```
/agent-notes on --global        # 运行时改全局默认，落盘持久化
```

或在插件配置里写 `enabled: true`（仅在该配置生效的 profile 里）。

会话级开关优先级高于全局：单独关掉某个会话后，改全局也不会影响它。

### 界面上的状态提示

不用敲命令也能一眼看到当前会话是否生效：**输入框工具行左侧**有一枚绿色胶囊
「● 笔记规范」，就挨着「完全权限/工作区内修改」那一排，**点击即切换**；
关闭时胶囊变灰。

它读的是**会话投影**（`agentNotes`），所以刷新、重连、切换会话都自动正确。
点击开关走的是官方斜杠命令通道（`/agent-notes on|off`），因此和手敲命令
**完全等价**，并且开关操作零 token。

> 设计说明：投影只折叠宿主自己写的 `command/run` 事件，本插件**不写会话日志**。
> 原因是插件零 `@deepseek-ai` 依赖，拿不到 `appendPluginRecord`；而退路
> `session.append('plugin:…')` 实测会写出 `ignorable=undefined` 的残废记录
> （`pluginRecordOf` 读不回），看着成功实则污染日志。走命令事件则完全绕开这个坑。

### 笔记看板：对话区多一个「笔记」tab

对话 / 轨迹 旁边会多出一个 **「笔记」** tab，里面就是上游那套成品看板
（架构基线 / 演进时间线 / 避坑智库 / 决策清单四个视图），**不自绘 UI**：

> tab 里用 iframe 加载 vendored 的上游资产
> `skills/agent-notes/assets/agent-notes-board.html`，宿主只负责把**当前会话仓库**的
> 笔记实时注入它预留的 `window.__INLINE_DATA__` 插槽。
>
> 理由：官方看板是 76K 成熟 UI（交叉引用入度、因果链路、多维筛选），自绘只会
> 更丑、越走越远。iframe 让视觉与交互跟随上游更新，本插件只维护数据适配层
> （`lib/board.js` 的 `buildInlineData`）与一处正文渲染补丁：上游 `parseMarkdown`
> 不认 GFM 表格，`lib/board-markdown.js` 只补这一条，其余沿用上游输出。

它读的是**实时磁盘内容**而不是静态快照：宿主注册只读 HTTP 路由
（`/agent-notes/ui`、`/agent-notes/board`、`/agent-notes/note`、`/agent-notes/health`），
每次切到该 tab 现读。

> 不用会话投影的原因：投影的 `view` 必须是**同步纯函数**，读不到文件系统
> （已核对源码 `view: state => wire.view(state)`）。
>
> 安全边界：路由只接受固定路径，只读 `notesRoot` 之下且拒绝任何 `..`；
> 会话解析不出笔记根时返回 **409**，绝不猜一个路径或退回进程目录。

**注入数据必须防住两件事**（都有回归测试）：

1. 笔记正文里出现 `</script>`、`<!--` 这类片段时，会把注入的脚本块从中间截断
   —— 表现为页面空白、计数恒为 0。做法是把 JSON 里每个 `<` 转成 `<`。
2. 用字符串形式调 `String.replace` 时，数据里的 `$&`、`` $` `` 会被当成反向引用
   展开，凭空塞进原 HTML 片段。必须用**函数式** replace。

开启后，模型侧还会自动获得：
- **`agent-notes` 技能** —— 完整方法论、六类判定、模板、归档规矩，按需加载；
- **`agent_notes_gate` 工具** —— 真跑校验脚本并返回**进程退出码**，不是「看起来合规」；
- **`agent_notes_status` 工具** —— 当前开关与笔记树概况；
- **会话级规范段** —— 只在开关打开的会话注入，不污染全局系统提示词。

### 工具作用于哪个仓库

`agent_notes_gate` / `agent_notes_status` 默认作用于**当前会话的仓库根**
（取自会话头的 `cwd`，向上找含 `.git` 的目录）。也可以显式传 `cwd` 覆盖。

**会话拿不到工作目录时会明确失败**，返回 `passed: false` + `reason: "NO_SESSION_CWD"`，
而不是退回进程当前目录。这一点是刻意的：DSH 进程的 cwd 是**它自己的安装目录**，
那里往往也有 `.agents/notes`（DSH 自己的开发笔记），退回过去会真的跑通并返回
绿 —— 但测的根本不是你的仓库，属于「假绿」。宁可报错。

> 所以：如果你的会话是在没有工作区的状态下建的，跑门禁请显式传 `cwd`。

### 目标仓库不必是 Node 项目

笔记是 Markdown，校验只认目录、文件名、必备小节与封印，不认语言 —— 任意技术栈的仓库都能用。
脚本由插件自己的 `node`（`process.execPath`）执行，**不查 PATH**，目标机器没装 Node 也能验。
边界：仓库内那份 `scripts/*.ts` 是给它自己的 CI 用的，仍需 Node；插件不往你的仓库装依赖。

### 零篇笔记不算通过

门禁只有在**至少验过一篇笔记**时才可能返回绿：

| 情况 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `.agents/notes` 不存在 | `passed: false`，`reason: NO_NOTES_TREE` |
| 目录存在但一篇笔记都没有 | `passed: false`，`reason: NO_NOTES_YET` |
| 有笔记且全部合规 | `passed: true`，`noteCount` 为实际篇数 |
| 有笔记但有违规 | `passed: false`，`exitCode: 1` + 具体诊断 |

底层的三个脚本在空目录上都 `exit 0` —— **没东西可验不等于验过了**。插件在调用脚本前
先拦一道，返回值里始终带 `noteCount`，让你能分辨这两种情况。

## 笔记长什么样

路径即状态，无总索引：

```
.agents/notes/{lifecycle}/{class}/yyyy-mm-dd-主题.md
```

| lifecycle | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `proposed/` | 未落地的方案稿 |
| `implemented/` | 已落地，随代码同步事实 |
| `rejected/` | 审慎否掉，仅当能防重犯时保留 |
| `archived/` | 已封存，SHA-256 封印，只增不改 |

class 封闭集（六种，不可自造）：`feature`、`bug-fix`、`simplification`、`architecture`、`process`、`testing`。

## 门禁：以退出码为准

```sh
node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-tree.ts       # 目录/分类/文件名/相对链接
node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-format.ts     # 头部/必备小节/备选方案/禁提案标题
node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-archived-agent-notes.ts  # 归档封印只增不改
```

这些门禁**已被故障注入证明会真的变红**（见下）。插件把门禁能力交给模型，但**强制仍应放在宿主仓库的 CI**：

```yaml
# .github/workflows/verify-notes.yml（模板见 skills/agent-notes/templates/verify-notes.yml）
- run: node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-*.ts
```

> ⚠️ **照抄上面两行会得到一条恒绿门禁。** 三个脚本在**空集合**上都 `exit 0`，只回答
> 「已有笔记合不合规」，不回答「有没有笔记」。要么在自己 CI 里补一步「至少一篇」的前置
> 判断，要么直接用 `tools/verify-notes.mjs`（空树报 `NO_NOTES_TREE`，有测试与故障注入守着）。

## 上游合并

内置内容来自上游固定 commit，可主动核对与合并：

```sh
npm run sync:latest                     # 与上游默认分支逐文件比对，判断是否落后
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs --auto      # 查上游 HEAD 并合并到它（CI 用，隐含 --yes）
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs --check    # 只比对钉死的那个 ref，零写入
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs            # 展示逐文件 diff 摘要，需要 --yes 才落盘
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs --yes      # 真的覆盖内置副本并记录清单
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs --ref <branch|commit>   # 换 ref
```

### 两条检查的区别（重要）

| 命令 | 回答的问题 | 会变红吗 |
|---|---|---|
| `--check` | 内置副本与**钉住的那个 commit** 是否逐字相同 | **几乎永远绿** —— ref 就是上次同步时的 commit |
| `--latest` | 内置副本与**上游默认分支**是否一致 | 会：落后即退出码 1 |

`--check` 单独用时是一条**恒绿的门禁**：它存在、每次都过、不验证任何东西。
真正该问的是「上游有没有新提交」，那只能拿本地清单去和上游分支逐文件比。
`--latest` 就是干这个的，`.github/workflows/verify.yml` 会在每次 push、
PR 和每日定时任务里跑它。

退出码语义：`0` 一致，`1` 已落后（真红），`2` 无法核对（网络/限流）。
**`2` 也让 job 变红** —— 否则「查不到」会被当成「没问题」。

**为什么默认钉 commit 而不是 `main`**：jsDelivr 对分支名的**清单缓存**实测会滞后——锚 `@main` 会拿到重构前的旧目录结构，导致路径枚举失败。但它的**文件读取**是准的（已验证同一文件逐字相同），所以 `--latest` 走「按本地清单逐个取文件内容比对」，不依赖远端枚举。

**为什么不用 GitHub API 查 HEAD**：实测未认证请求 60 次/小时就 403（rate limit exceeded），CI 里天天跑必然撞墙。

合并后必须重跑：

```sh
node --test tools/*.test.mjs && node tools/fault-injection.mjs
```

### 项目内副本：只提示，不擅自改（`/agent-notes sync-skill`）

除了插件自带那份，**项目仓库里通常还有一份** `.agents/skills/agent-notes/`
（被项目 git 跟踪，供项目自己的 CI 门禁使用）。插件自更新**只管自己那份**。

为什么不去自动改项目那份：它属于项目仓库的正式内容。插件擅自改写会

- 让用户的 `git status` 突然变脏；
- 让本地与 CI 跑不同版本的校验脚本；
- 往项目仓库里注入意料之外的改动。

所以这里是**检测 + 提示 + 用户确认**：

1. 开关打开时，插件比对项目副本与内置版本；落后就在注入的规范末尾追加一段提示，
   明确要求模型**先问用户**，而不是自己动手；
2. 用户同意后跑 `/agent-notes sync-skill` —— 默认只打印差异（预览），
   加 `--yes` 才真的落盘；
3. 项目里多出来的文件（内置版本没有的）**不会被删除**，那是项目自己的东西。

#### CI 不用单独同步

项目 CI 的调用链是：

```
ci.yml → npm run verify-notes → tsx .agents/skills/agent-notes/scripts/*.ts
```

`ci.yml` 里只写 `npm run verify-notes`，**不含版本号或文件清单**。所以同步脚本目录
就等于更新了 CI 实际执行的校验逻辑，`ci.yml`、`package.json`、`.github/` 都不用改。

这些脚本**零外部依赖**，只用 `node:` 内置模块，换版本不会引入新 npm 包。

### 技能副本会自己更新（异步，不阻塞启动）

`skills/agent-notes` 是 vendored 副本。为了让已安装的插件不必手动同步，插件在
`apply` 时**后台**拉一次本仓库的技能目录（`lib/self-update.js`）：

- **绝不阻塞启动**：`scheduleSkillUpdate()` 是 fire-and-forget，网络再慢也不拖慢
  `apply`。代价是启动那一刻技能可能还是旧的。
- **失败静默**：断网、CDN 不可达、任何文件拉不到 → 整批放弃，**保留现有副本**。
  技能旧一点可以接受，不可用不行。
- **原子写入**：逐文件写 `.tmp` 再 `rename`，中途失败不留半套内容。
- **内容相同不写盘**：避免每次启动都改 mtime、触发无谓的热替换。
- **热替换**：真的写入新内容后调宿主的 `SkillProviderControl.invalidate()`，
  宿主丢弃缓存

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that freezes tool declarations to improve prompt cache stability.
plugins.readme_text:
# Prompt Freeze / 提示前缀冻结

冻结会话的工具声明和命名提示段落（system prompt），防止意外改动导致的缓存失效，审阅后决定是否修改。npm 包 `@lemonel/dsh-prompt-freeze`，不保证缓存命中，也不阻止或限制工具执行。

[English](./README.en.md)

## 功能

- 首次真实请求建快照，之后原样回放。
- 面板按 tools / sections / contexts / variables 列差异，点「应用此版本」才生效（需空闲）。
- contexts、variables、`live` 段落不冻结，标「实时 · 缓存已失效」；「确认实时差异」只停止显示。
- 自动应用：阈值按会话设（默认 24K tokens），仅下一条真实用户消息触发。
- 写入结果不确定时停下，选保留或重建；子会话自动保留并冒泡到父面板。
- 界面跟随 DSH locale；工具名、schema、原文不翻译。

## 安装

DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`–`0.2.1`。

一条命令安装预构建包，无需本地编译：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lemonel/dsh-prompt-freeze/releases/download/v1.0.0/lemonel-dsh-prompt-freeze-1.0.0.tgz
```

将 `web` 替换为实际使用的 profile；安装后确认 bundle 已启用，重载后端并刷新页面。

也可以从 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/lemonel/dsh-prompt-freeze/releases/tag/v1.0.0) 下载 tgz，在 Plugins 页安装并勾选 bundle。

从源码打包（在仓库根目录执行）：

```sh
npm ci && npm pack
```

手动接入：

```yaml
- id: prompt-freeze
  name: '@lemonel/dsh-prompt-freeze'
  config:
    directory: /absolute/private/path/prompt-freeze
```

`directory` 默认 `<profile 目录>/cache-guard/<profile 身份哈希>`；`autoApplyBelow` 支持 K/M（K=1000），留空关闭。装完重载后端、刷新页面。

## 使用

入口在输入栏左侧，点击「Prompt Freeze」：

![输入栏左侧的入口](docs/trigger.png)

![会话面板](docs/panel-zh.png)

1. 眼睛按钮看差异。
2. 有差异：重新审阅最新版本 → 应用此版本。
3. 仅实时内容变化：确认实时差异。

不开自动应用时，不点即沿用活动版本。

## 数据与边界

- 状态在 `<profile 目录>/cache-guard/<身份哈希>/`：会话 manifest + `payload-<sha256>.json`；文件 0600，目录 0700。
- 单进程独占，无跨进程锁。
- payload 不回收，目录只增。
- 不承诺缓存命中或计费；模型变化、compact、上游过期仍会失效。
- 外层 assembly 可在快照外追加工具，最终请求可能与快照不一致。
- 历史兼容：`source.kind=prompt-freeze`，仍接受 `cache-guard`、`tool-declaration-snapshot`；存储目录沿用 `cache-guard`。

## 兼容性

| DSH | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.1` / `0.2.0-rc.2` | 通过 |
| `0.2.1-alpha.4` | 通过（上游移除 `both` 模式） |

`@deepseek-ai/*` 为 `peerDependencies` 且带预发布区间；越界版本启动时禁用插件。

## 开发

```sh
npm install && npm run typecheck && npm test
```

源码使用普通 TS（strict）：入口为 `src/backend_index.ts` 和 `src/frontend_index.ts`，实现分别放在 `src/backend/` 与 `src/frontend/`，`src/shared/` 为两端共用的 RPC 契约；`npm run build` 生成 `lib/`。`lib/` 不提交、不手改，本地链接安装前先构建。

plugins.description: Token usage, cost estimation, API balance, usage trends and model share - a dashboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 用量看板 · dsh-usage-dashboard

DeepSeek Harness 的桌面端用量可视化看板插件。侧边栏一个图标，点开就是一整页的 Token 用量、费用估算、账户余额、使用趋势和模型占比 —— 所有数字都从你自己的会话日志里实时算出来。

![用量看板](docs/screenshot.png)

## 功能

| 区域 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **读数条** | Token 总量（含调用次数与缓存命中率）、今日费用、本月费用、历史累计费用、API 余额（充值钱包 + 赠送额度；未登录时显示状态而不是报错） |
| **Token 构成** | 堆叠比例条 + 明细表：输入（未命中缓存）/ 输出 / 缓存命中 / 缓存写入，各自数量与占比，底部给出缓存命中率 |
| **模型占比** | 按总 Token 排序的模型份额条，含 Token 数与各模型费用；同一模型跨多个 provider 会自动合并，悬停可看来源 |
| **使用趋势** | 平滑折线（单调三次插值，零用量日不会被画到基线以下）+ 悬浮十字线 + 当日明细卡片；7 / 30 / 90 / 182 天可切换，`←` `→` 逐日移动 |
| **活跃热力图** | 近半年逐日方格，颜色越深用量越大；悬停格子会描边高亮，并在下方图例行原位显示当天明细（浮层不会遮挡网格） |

折线与热力图统一使用 DeepSeek 蓝配色阶 `#dff2fe → #a0dcfd → #60b3fe → #0c70f3`；其余结构与控件全部沿用宿主主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`），亮色/暗色自动跟随。

## 安装

### 安装后长什么样

- 侧边栏底部、设置上方，多出一个柱状图图标
- 点击它，中栏整页变成看板
- 插件管理页里能看到「用量看板」条目及其图标

### 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.x
- Node.js `>= 20`

### 安装方式

**方式一：本地目录安装（推荐，改代码即时生效）**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JeffKeeping/dsh-usage-dashboard.git
```

然后在 Harness 里执行（把路径换成你的实际克隆路径）：

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<绝对路径>/dsh-usage-dashboard
```

或用 CLI：

```bash
dsh plugin install <绝对路径>/dsh-usage-dashboard
```

安装立即生效。若界面还没出现新的侧边栏图标，按 `Ctrl+R` 刷新一次窗口（客户端代码是模块化加载的，刷新后才换成磁盘上的最新版本）。

**方式二：从 npm 安装**

```bash
dsh plugin install dsh-usage-dashboard
```

### 验证安装

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:<你的端口>/dsh-usage-dashboard/snapshot
```

返回 `{"ok":true,...}` 即 Host 半已就绪。首次打开会扫描全部会话日志，通常一两秒；之后走 revision 缓存，只有变动的会话会重读（实测冷读约 800ms，热读约 25ms）。

## 配置

价格表在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，安装后也可在插件管理页修改：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-usage-dashboard
      name: dsh-usage-dashboard
      config:
        historyDays: 182      # 日序列与热力图窗口（折线图从中切片）
        maxSessions: 600      # 最多扫描最近 N 个会话
        pricing:
          currency: CNY
          unit: 1000000       # 单价按「每 N 个 token」计
          default: { miss: 2, hit: 0.2, write: 2, output: 3 }
          models:
            deepseek-v4.1-flash: { miss: 2, hit: 0.2, write: 2, output: 3 }
            deepseek-v4-pro: { miss: 4, hit: 1, write: 4, output: 12 }
```

- 模型键先按 **完全匹配**，再按 **最长前缀** 匹配（`deepseek-v4-pro` 也覆盖 `deepseek-v4-pro-2026`），都不中的落到 `default`
- 费用公式：`(miss × 输入 + hit × 缓存命中 + write × 缓存写入 + output × 输出) / unit`

> ⚠️ 内置单价是**估算的起点**，不是账单。改成你实际付费的价格。看板页脚始终显示当前生效的币种与单位。

### 计费口径

会话日志里的 `TokenUsage` 遵循 Anthropic Messages 语义（DeepSeek 路由走的就是这套协议）：

- `inputTokens` 是**未命中缓存**的输入
- `cacheReadTokens` / `cacheWriteTokens` 是**独立计数**，不是 `inputTokens` 的子集
- `prompt = input + cacheRead + cacheWrite`，`tokens = prompt + output`

## 工作原理

全部数字都从会话日志推导，插件本身不持有事实来源：

```
assistant/message ─┬─ data.usage          → 四类 token 计数
                   └─ data.message.source → provider + model
```

- Host 半通过 `sessionPersistence` 读取日志，按 `SessionPersistenceSnapshot.revision` 做增量缓存（缓存挂在 `Symbol.for` 全局上，HMR 重挂载不会重新全量扫描）
- 只读一个路由：`GET /dsh-usage-dashboard/snapshot[?refresh=1]`，`no-store`
- 客户端只负责渲染，每 60 秒拉一次快照，手动刷新会同时重读账户余额

## 卸载

```
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-usage-dashboard
```

## 已知限制

- 只统计本进程 `sessionPersistence.list()` 能看到且没有被 `maxSessions` 截断的会话
- 余额需要宿主挂载 `deepseekAccount`；没有时会显示「未启用」而不是失败
- 会话日志若被其他工具归档移走，不会计入

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: WIP (not published yet): Gemini CLI subagent for DeepSeek Harness. Gemini CLI does not offer Gemini 4 yet; use dsh-subagent-antigravity for Gemini 4.
plugins.readme_text:
---
description: "Gemini subagent: drive the official Google Gemini CLI as a one-shot coding subagent inside DeepSeek Harness (subagent_gemini delegation tool)."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

# dsh-subagent-gemini

> **发布状态：暂未发布到 npm / DSH 插件市场。**
> Gemini CLI 目前尚未提供 Gemini 4，且本插件需要用户自备 Gemini API key 才能完成端到端验证；
> 在验证通过前不提交市场收录，避免把未经验证的插件放给用户。代码、测试与 CI 均已就绪，验证后可发布。
>
> 想用 Gemini 4 请安装 [`dsh-subagent-antigravity`](https://github.com/PipeDream941/dsh-subagent-antigravity)。

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Adds a **Gemini subagent** to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a parent session can call
`subagent_gemini` to run a Google Gemini CLI coding agent in a **separate process**
inside the parent workspace, let it edit files and run commands on its own, and
get only the final answer back.

The shape is the same as the official Codex subagent (`subagent_codex`) and the
community Cursor subagent (`cursor_code`):

- **Fresh process, fresh session** — every delegation spawns a new `gemini --acp`;
- **Final answer only** — the child's thoughts, tool calls and stderr never enter the parent conversation;
- **One task per run** — no follow-up input or continuation (use the native `subagent`/`fork` backends for those);
- **Safe diagnostics** — failures report fixed stage/category facts, never stderr, paths or credentials.

> Community plugin; not affiliated with Google. Gemini CLI is Google's official CLI — this plugin only drives it from DSH.

## How it works

```
parent session (DeepSeek model)
   │  calls tool subagent_gemini({ description, prompt })
   ▼
DSH subagent seam (ctx.subagents)
   │  provider: gemini (registered by this plugin)
   ▼
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp (official ACP subagent backend)
   │  spawn, ACP handshake, auto-answered permissions, process-range cleanup, safe diagnostics
   ▼
gemini --acp --skip-trust  (separate process, parent cwd)
   │  uses Gemini CLI's own tools (file edits / shell / search / MCP …)
   ▼
final answer → parent conversation
```

This plugin owns the Gemini-specific parts — **locating the executable**, **validating configuration**
and **detecting credentials at load time with actionable guidance**. Process lifecycle and the ACP
protocol are handled by DSH's official backend, so a DSH upgrade does not require rewriting the protocol here.

## Requirements

| Dependency | Version / notes |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.2` series (provides `ctx.subagents` and the ACP subagent backend) |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24` |
| Google Gemini CLI | a build that supports `--acp` (`0.60+`, latest recommended) |
| Gemini credential | Gemini Developer API key (recommended), or Vertex AI / Code Assist variables |

Install the CLI:

```bash
npm install -g @google/gemini-cli
gemini --version
```

## Install the plugin

**From the DSH plugin market (recommended):** search for `dsh-subagent-gemini`, install and enable it.

**From the command line:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-gemini
```

Then add the package to that profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart (or let the
profile recompose):

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": ["…", "dsh-subagent-gemini"]
  }
}
```

Once enabled, every agent sees the global tool `subagent_gemini` (a running session picks it up on its next request).

## Credentials (important)

Gemini CLI needs its own credential. **Google account browser login (OAuth) no longer works**: Google retired
the individual Gemini Code Assist OAuth client for Gemini CLI, and the CLI reports
*"This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals"*.
Use an **API key** instead:

1. Create a key at <https://aistudio.google.com/apikey>;
2. Store it where Gemini CLI looks (no plugin config required):

```bash
printf 'GEMINI_API_KEY=your-key\n' > ~/.gemini/.env
chmod 600 ~/.gemini/.env
```

Gemini CLI loads `~/.gemini/.env` automatically. Environment variables also work:

- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — Gemini Developer API;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true` + `GOOGLE_API_KEY` — Vertex AI;
- `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true` — Google Code Assist license.

To pass variables to the child explicitly, use the plugin's `env` config (see below). The plugin never reads,
logs or returns secret values.

## Usage

The model calls it like any other delegation tool:

```json
{
  "name": "subagent_gemini",
  "arguments": {
    "description": "Fix login timeout",
    "prompt": "In the workspace, find the login request timeout and raise it from 5s to 15s, run the related tests, and reply only with what you changed and the test result."
  }
}
```

- `description` — 3–5 word task name shown in the subagent list;
- `prompt` — a **self-contained** task; the child cannot see the parent conversation, so include paths, constraints and acceptance criteria.

When the run finishes the parent receives a completion notice with Gemini's final answer or a safe failure
diagnostic. The child's tool traffic and reasoning stay out of the parent session.

## Configuration

Override the `subagent-gemini` entry's `config` in a profile patch:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | `gemini` | Name registered on `ctx.subagents`; must be unique in one profile |
| `command` | empty (auto-detect) | Path to the `gemini` executable; empty searches `PATH`, then `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, … |
| `args` | `['--acp', '--skip-trust']` | CLI arguments; `--acp` is always kept, `--skip-trust` is present by default |
| `model` | empty (CLI default) | Fixed model id such as `gemini-2.5-flash`; becomes one `--model` argument |
| `permission` | `allow` | Auto-answer for child permission requests: `allow` approves (edits/shell), `reject` declines (read-only) |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment variables layered over the credential-scrubbed parent environment |
| `disposeEofGraceMs` | `6000` | Time the child gets to flush after stdin EOF before escalation |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `3000` | Failure-observation and SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation grace |

Example — fixed model, read-only child:

```yaml
- id: subagent-gemini
  config:
    model: gemini-2.5-flash
    permission: reject
```

## Security and permissions

- `permission: allow` means **unattended**: the child may edit workspace files and run commands without a human
  approval prompt. That is what makes delegated coding tasks possible; use it in trusted workspaces and review
  `git diff` afterwards.
- `--skip-trust` trusts the parent workspace for the child session only, so a delegation never stalls on an
  interactive trust prompt.
- The child is a separate process with its own credential environment: DSH's subprocess seam scrubs credential-like
  variables from the parent environment; only variables in `env` are forwarded.
- No telemetry. No credential is read, logged or returned by this plugin; the key is managed by Gemini CLI itself.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Delegation fails with a `process-start` diagnostic | `gemini` not found. `npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`, or set `command` to an absolute path |
| `Gemini API key is missing or not configured` | No credential. Write `~/.gemini/.env` as above (`chmod 600`) |
| `This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals` | The retired OAuth login is in use. Switch to an API key |
| Child starts but never answers / times out | Check network reachability of the Gemini API; if it needs a proxy, put `HTTPS_PROXY` in the plugin's `env` |
| Want to check the machine setup | Run `npm run smoke` in the plugin checkout (costs one API request and prints PONG) |

## Compatibility and development

- Depends on the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp@0.2.1-rc.2`, so protocol work tracks the official backend;
- Unit tests: `npm test` (32 cases: config normalization, executable discovery, credential detection);
- End-to-end self-check: `npm run smoke` (requires an API key);
- Reference implementations: the official Codex subagent (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`) and the official ACP
  backend (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp`); all three share the same `ctx.subagents` contract.
